CVE-2026-92241.desc:
The AVRCP browsing channel's L2CAP receive-buffer callback, browsing_avrcp_l2cap_alloc_buf() in subsys/bluetooth/host/classic/avrcp.c, allocated from the shared avctp_browsing_rx_pool with K_FOREVER. L2CAP invokes that callback from the Bluetooth RX work queue thread (bt_workq, "BT RX WQ"), both for the head buffer of a new SDU and — through l2cap_br_alloc_frag() and net_buf_append_bytes() — for every further fragment of a reassembled SDU. That same thread is the only context that ever releases these buffers, after bt_l2cap_br_recv_seg() delivers a completed SDU and calls net_buf_unref(), so a wait taken there can never be satisfied.

The pool holds CONFIG_BT_MAX_CONN + 1 buffers of CONFIG_BT_AVRCP_BROWSING_L2CAP_MTU bytes (two buffers of 339 bytes in the default configuration). A connected browsing peer can drain it because bt_l2cap_br_recv_seg() in subsys/bluetooth/host/classic/l2cap_br.c accepts the SDU length declared in an SAR_START segment without bounding it by br_chan->rx.mtu: a peer that announces a large SDU and then streams continuation segments forces one pool buffer per segment-worth of data. Once the pool is empty the next allocation blocks forever inside the callback.

Triggering the flaw requires a build with CONFIG_BT_CLASSIC and the experimental CONFIG_BT_AVRCP_BROWSING option, an application that registers AVRCP callbacks, and a BR/EDR peer that has established the AVRCP control channel and then the browsing channel, which requires an encrypted (paired) link. No malformed packet is needed — a few hundred bytes of ordinary segmented L2CAP traffic suffice.

The consequence is a permanent hang of the whole Bluetooth host, not just of AVRCP: the blocked thread drains bt_dev.rx_queue for all HCI ACL data and low-priority events and also runs the host's internal work items, so all connections stop being serviced and the state is unrecoverable without a reboot. There is no memory-corruption or information-disclosure component. The fix allocates with K_NO_WAIT, so an empty pool now yields a local-busy indication or a channel disconnect that the application can recover from.
CVE-2026-92241.path: adjacent network, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-127031.desc:
In Eclipse AAS4J before 3.0.1, `XmlSchemaValidator.validateSchema()` (and `AASXValidator.validateSchema()`, which calls it) validates untrusted XML with a default JAXP `Validator` that resolves external DTDs and external entities. An attacker who supplies a crafted AAS XML document or AASX package can read local files from the host, send their contents out-of-band to an attacker-controlled server, and make the validating process send arbitrary outbound requests (SSRF). Validation still returns no errors.



Details:



- Vulnerable code: `dataformat-xml/src/main/java/org/eclipse/digitaltwin/aas4j/v3/dataformat/xml/XmlSchemaValidator.java`. `schema.newValidator().validate(new StreamSource(...))` runs without `ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD` / `ACCESS_EXTERNAL_SCHEMA` restrictions and without `disallow-doctype-decl`.



- Second entry point: `dataformat-aasx/src/main/java/org/eclipse/digitaltwin/aas4j/v3/dataformat/aasx/AASXValidator.java`. The AAS XML part of an `.aasx` package is passed unchanged to the vulnerable validator.



- `XmlDeserializer` (Jackson/Woodstox) is not affected, because DTD support is disabled by default there.



- Present since the initial import of the code base (commit `cc9da52`).



- Fix: harden the validator by setting `ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD` and `ACCESS_EXTERNAL_SCHEMA` to `""` and rejecting `DOCTYPE` declarations. The bundled `AAS.xsd` does not need DTDs, so no functionality is lost.
products: Eclipse AAS Model for Java (Eclipse AAS4J)
CVE-2026-127031.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-127102.desc:
In Eclipse BaSyx Go Components versions up to and including 1.1.2, ABAC-enabled deployments of the Submodel Repository and the AAS Environment return Submodel Elements that the caller is not authorized to read from `GET /submodels/{submodelIdentifier}/submodel-elements`.



If an access rule grants READ on a single Submodel Element through a `$sme` `REFERABLE` object, the list route returns every element of that Submodel, including its value, as soon as one element matches the caller's rules. The single-element route and the full Submodel read enforce the same rule and deny access to the other elements. An authenticated caller with a READ grant for one element of a Submodel can therefore read all other elements of that Submodel.



The issue is fixed in Eclipse BaSyx Go Components v1.1.3.
CVE-2026-127102.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

The service accepts commands in DJI's proprietary DUML protocol without any authentication. Exploitation requires network access to TCP port 16000 on the board and that the unit is not connected to another controlling host. The same commands are also accepted over the USB operator port. Confirmed on a physical device.



NOTE: This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer. DJI has discontinued AeroScope Mobile and no fixed firmware is available.

An authenticated remote attacker who has been invited to a group with share-admin privileges, and who knows a group share-right UUID, can therefore delete that group's share-right record without accepting the invitation or after declining it. CVE-2026-121808.title: Memory exhaustion via compressed Erlang terms in the elixir-grpc Erlpack codec
CVE-2026-121808.desc:
Improper Handling of Highly Compressed Data (Data Amplification) vulnerability in elixir-grpc grpc_core and grpc allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server memory via a compressed Erlang external term in a gRPC message body.

GRPC.Codec.Erlpack.decode/2 (grpc_core/lib/grpc/codec/erlpack.ex, and lib/grpc/codec/erlpack.ex before the package split) passes the message body to :erlang.binary_to_term/2. That function inflates a compressed term in full before it returns. The codec sets no limit on the decoded size, and its type checks run only on the decoded term. The server's max_body_size limit counts the compressed bytes of the request. A request with Content-Type: application/grpc+erlpack can therefore make the server allocate a term much larger than the request body.

This issue affects grpc: from 0.4.0 before 1.0.0; grpc_core: from 1.0.0 before 1.1.0.
CVE-2026-121808.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-123635.desc:
Missing Release of Resource after Effective Lifetime vulnerability in elixir-grpc grpc_server allows a client to stall all later calls on a shared HTTP/2 connection via calls that the server refuses while their DATA frames are in flight.

The stream handler grpc_stream_h (grpc_server/src/grpc_stream_h.erl) requests flow from Cowboy only for request data that has arrived. When the server refuses a call early, for example because the body exceeds max_body_size or the method is not implemented, Cowboy drops the DATA frames still in flight for that stream. Their bytes are not returned to the connection flow-control window. After enough refused calls the window is empty. No call on that connection can then send a request body, and each call waits until its deadline. Other connections are not affected.

This issue affects grpc_server: from 1.0.0 before 1.1.0.
CVE-2026-123635.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-124278.title: Path bindings ignored for gRPC Content-Types on transcoded routes in elixir-grpc grpc_server
CVE-2026-124278.desc:
Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key vulnerability in elixir-grpc grpc_server and grpc allows an attacker to make a handler act on a resource other than the one named in the URL of an HTTP-transcoded route, via a request with a gRPC Content-Type.

Only the transcoding clause of GRPC.Server.do_handle_request/4 (grpc_server/lib/grpc/server.ex, and lib/grpc/server.ex before the package split) applies the route's path bindings to the request message. The Cowboy handler picks that clause from the request Content-Type, not from the route. A request to a transcoded URL with application/grpc or application/grpc-web is decoded from the body alone, so every path-bound field takes its value from the body. A gateway, proxy rule or WAF that authorizes on the URL path sees one resource while the handler receives another.

This issue affects grpc_server: from 1.0.0 before 1.1.0; grpc: from 0.8.0 before 1.0.0.
CVE-2026-124278.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-121809.title: CPU exhaustion via a truncated gRPC message on streaming RPCs in elixir-grpc grpc_server
CVE-2026-121809.desc:

GRPC.Server.Adapters.Cowboy.read_stream/1 (grpc_server/lib/grpc/server/adapters/cowboy.ex, and the Cowboy adapter in grpc before the package split) asks for more data whenever the buffer does not hold a complete message. Once the request body has ended, every further read returns an empty chunk, so the buffer never changes and the function retries without end. A single 5-byte length prefix sent with END_STREAM keeps one scheduler busy for as long as the connection stays open, and repeated requests exhaust all schedulers.

This issue affects grpc_server: from 1.0.0 before 1.1.0; grpc: from 0.3.1 before 1.0.0.

The gRPC length prefix of a message is not checked before the message is buffered. Each stream can therefore buffer up to one full read beyond the configured limit before it is refused, and many concurrent streams exhaust node memory. Releases before 1.0.6 apply no limit to streaming requests at all.

This issue affects grpc_server: from 1.0.0 before 1.1.0.

CVE-2026-128986.desc:

An encoded slash (`%2F`) inside a path value is a segment separator for the access check but part of the value for the router, so a request can match a narrow `ROUTE` rule while the handler returns a different, larger resource.



An authenticated caller whose rules grant READ only on parts of a resource can therefore read the whole resource. In the DPP API, a rule such as `/v1/dpps/*/elements/*`, meant to grant only passport elements, also grants the complete passport whose identifier contains `/elements/`. In the Submodel Repository, AAS Repository and AAS Environment, a rule such as `/submodels/*/submodel-elements/*/attachment`, meant to grant only file attachments, also grants the complete element whose stored idShort contains `%2F`.

CVE-2026-129131.desc: Gameyfin before 2.6.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass login-required mode by calling Hilla endpoints annotated with @AnonymousAllowed. Attackers can POST to synchronous endpoint methods such as GameEndpoint.sync, which LiveSubscriptionSecurity never checks, to retrieve game catalog metadata, libraries, platforms, plugins and game requests.
CVE-2026-129131.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-129132.desc: MRBS before 1.13.0 contains an LDAP injection vulnerability in web/lib/MRBS/Auth/AuthLdap.php that interpolates unescaped login usernames into DN search and group-membership filters. Attackers with valid directory credentials outside the required group can submit crafted usernames that make the group filter always true, bypassing access restrictions.
CVE-2026-129132.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-129133.desc: MRBS before 1.13.0 contains a CSV formula injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject spreadsheet formulas because the escape() function in web/report.php fails to neutralize leading formula characters. Attackers can store formulas in booking names, descriptions or custom fields that execute when privileged users open exported CSV reports, enabling data exfiltration or command execution via DDE.
CVE-2026-129133.path: remote, needs a user login, needs user action

CVE-2026-129134.title: MRBS before 1.13.0 Password Reset Poisoning via Host Header Injection
CVE-2026-129134.desc: MRBS before 1.13.0 contains a password reset poisoning vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect reset links by forging the Host header when $url_base is unset. Attackers can request a reset for a victim so AuthDb::notifyUser() emails a link pointing to their host, capturing the reset key when opened to take over accounts including administrators.
CVE-2026-129134.path: remote, no login, needs user action

CVE-2026-129135.desc: picoquic before 2026.11.05.3e2e3d3 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in picoquic_decode_time_stamp_frame() that allows remote QUIC peers to corrupt stored timestamps by sending oversized TIME_STAMP values. Attackers on connections negotiating the TIME_STAMP extension can send large values shifted by ack_delay_exponent to wrap the result, corrupting RTT and bandwidth estimation and degrading congestion control.
CVE-2026-129135.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-63150.title: Omnispace Agora Project 26.10.0 CSRF via Administrator Account Creation
CVE-2026-63150.desc: Omnispace Agora Project through 26.10.0 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows remote attackers to forge privileged actions such as administrator user creation by merging $_GET and $_POST parameters without requiring an anti-CSRF token. Attackers can craft a malicious link or auto-navigating page that issues a plain GET request, exploiting the lack of CSRF protection and SameSite=Lax cookie behavior on top-level navigations to create unauthorized administrator accounts.
CVE-2026-63150.path: remote, no login, needs user action

CVE-2026-63151.title: Omnispace Agora Project 26.10.0 Predictable Token Information Disclosure via DisplayIcal
CVE-2026-63151.desc: Omnispace Agora Project through 26.10.0 contains a predictable token generation vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access private calendar data by exploiting a missing dateCrea value that causes the md5Id token to collapse to md5(calendarId.userId), both small enumerable integers. Attackers can compute valid tokens and request the misc&action=DisplayIcal endpoint with a forged md5Id to read any user's private calendar events without authentication.
CVE-2026-63151.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-63155.desc: Omnispace Agora Project through 26.10.0 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows remote attackers to redirect users to arbitrary external URLs by manipulating the objUrl parameter in Ctrl.php's redir() function. Attackers can craft login links with objUrl set to a malicious site, causing the application to issue an HTTP 302 redirect to that external URL, which can be abused for phishing and credential theft.
CVE-2026-63155.path: remote, no login, needs user action

CVE-2026-63164.desc: Omnispace Agora Project through 26.10.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to access another user's private mail by supplying a crafted reloadMailTypeId parameter to Ctrl::getCurObj() without a readRight() ownership check in CtrlMail.php. Attackers can manipulate the mail identifier value, such as reloadMailTypeId=mail-1, to retrieve the title and body of private messages belonging to other users, resulting in unauthorized disclosure of sensitive communications.
CVE-2026-63164.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-63166.desc: Omnispace Agora Project through 26.10.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject malicious HTML markup by controlling imported directory data or an uploaded CSV file, as values are rendered into table cell text and value attributes after only Txt::utf8Encode() with no HTML escaping in VuePersonsImportExport.php. Attackers can craft a CSV cell containing an attribute-breakout payload that is rendered verbatim and executed in the browser of the administrator performing the import, leading to arbitrary script execution in the administrative context.
CVE-2026-63166.path: remote, no login, needs user action

CVE-2026-63167.desc: Omnispace Agora Project through 26.10.0 contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated general administrators to inject arbitrary SQL by setting the personsSort session value, which is concatenated unsanitized into ORDER BY clauses in MdlUser.php and MdlSpace.php. Attackers can submit an error-based extractvalue payload through personsSort to leak database information, such as the MariaDB version, via the user and space listing pages.
CVE-2026-63167.path: remote, needs admin rights, no user action

CVE-2026-63170.desc: Omnispace Agora Project through 26.10.0 contains a predictable token generation vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge the shared-calendar iCal share token by deriving md5Id() from predictable fields such as object creation time, which is self-disclosed through autorDate and the iCal CREATED field. Attackers can compute the creation minute and forge the md5Id token to access and read a shared calendar's iCal feed without authorization.
CVE-2026-63170.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-107398.title: Indico: Local file disclosure through offline-copy path traversal
CVE-2026-107398.desc: Indico is a feature-rich event management system. Prior to version 3.3.14, due to a path traversal vulnerability when building an "offline copy" of an event, a malicious event manager has the ability to retrieve the content of any local file that's readable by the user running Indico on the server. This issue has been patched in version 3.3.14.
CVE-2026-107398.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-123177.title: Dnf5: dnf5daemon-server: dnf5daemon-server: unauthenticated privileged cmdline package fetch/open via add_cmdline_packages
CVE-2026-123177.desc: A flaw was found in dnf5daemon-server. Unauthenticated D-Bus methods pass caller-controlled URL or .rpm path patterns into a root-privileged cmdline package loader that may store fetched content in a world-readable cache without size limits, or open local paths as root, allowing a local attacker to disclose privileged content and to deny service via disk exhaustion.
CVE-2026-123177.path: local access needed, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-123965.title: Jet Admin cloud platform prompt injection
CVE-2026-123965.desc: A prompt injection vulnerability in all versions of Jet Admin Cloud Platform allows a remote attacker with a free account to expose sensitive .env configuration files and exfiltrate critical credentials. Mitigated via sandbox component around October 29, 2026.
CVE-2026-123965.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-124041.desc: Catalis/Patriot Properties WebPro 5.0 allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary SQL queries against the underlying MSSQL database, enabling exfiltration of sensitive property and  taxpayer information.
CVE-2026-124041.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-124666.desc:
Authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability in Apache APISIX.



On a route where multi-auth falls back from wolf-rbac to another successful authenticator, client-supplied Wolf identity headers can remain in the request. A downstream service that relies on those documented headers may therefore receive an identity that was not established by the successful authenticator.



This issue affects Apache APISIX: from 3.8.0 through 3.19.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.20.0, which fixes the issue.
CVE-2026-124666.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-124679.title: Apache APISIX: jwe-decrypt and forward-auth may pass a client-supplied identity header
CVE-2026-124679.desc:
Authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability in Apache APISIX.



On routes using jwe-decrypt with strict: false and a
forward_header distinct from the token header an unauthenticated
client can supply the value the upstream treats as gateway-decrypted
plaintext. Similar can happen when forward-auth is configured with allow_degradation: true, and the auth service is unavailable.



This issue affects Apache APISIX: from 3.18.0 through 3.19.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.20.0, which fixes the issue.
CVE-2026-124679.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-124680.title: Apache APISIX: Route-level authentication bypass via path normalization mismatch between routing and upstream forwarding
CVE-2026-124680.desc:
Interpretation Conflict, resulting in (Incorrect Authorization) vulnerability in Apache APISIX.



An unauthenticated client can reach upstream paths protected
by a route-level auth plugin when a route without auth exists on the
same upstream and the upstream does not collapse encoded dot segments.



This issue affects Apache APISIX: from 0.9 through 3.19.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.20.0, which fixes the issue.
CVE-2026-124680.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-124716.desc:
Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Apache APISIX.



An authenticated user who holds any one of a route's required permissions or scopes can reach the protected upstream without the others, including HTTP methods the authorization server denied.



This issue affects Apache APISIX: from 1.4.0 through 3.19.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.20.0, which fixes the issue.
CVE-2026-124716.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-124719.desc:
Authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability in Apache APISIX.



When a Route's configured headers carry a caller identity and the OpenAPI document declares
the same header, a caller can act as another identity against the
upstream API. This issue affects Apache APISIX: from 3.19.0 before 3.20.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.20.0, which fixes the issue.
CVE-2026-124719.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-124723.desc:
Interpretation Conflict, leading to Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Apache APISIX.



With match_uri_encoded_slash enabled and skip_mtls_uri_regex
configured, a client without a certificate can reach an upstream
behind a route that requires one, limited to request paths that decode
to an exempted URI. This issue affects Apache APISIX: from 3.18.0 through 3.19.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.20.0, which fixes the issue.
CVE-2026-124723.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-124726.desc:
Relative Path Traversal, with Unintended Proxy vulnerability in Apache APISIX.



A caller of the MCP endpoint can invoke endpoints the OpenAPI document
never declared, under the declared tool's HTTP method, using the credentials the
Route adds. This issue affects Apache APISIX: from 3.19.0 before 3.20.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.20.0, which fixes the issue.
CVE-2026-124726.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-126091.title: iDentalSoft website information exposure
CVE-2026-126091.desc: Dental practice sites hosted with iDentalSoft send a JSON response to any user who loads certain pages containing sensitive information, including OAuth credentials, password hashes, and PII. Fixed in iDentalSoft 14.0.3.
CVE-2026-126091.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-128068.desc: rails-html-sanitizer is responsible for sanitizing HTML fragments in Rails applications. From 1.0.3 through 1.7.1, Rails::HTML::PermitScrubber checks SVG href and xlink:href local references with a pattern whose line-start anchor and whitespace class cause an all-whitespace value to be rescanned from each line start. An attacker who supplies HTML can cause quadratic CPU consumption when an application customizes its allowed tags to include an SVG reference element such as use and permits href or xlink:href. The default allowed tag configuration is not affected. CRuby 3.2 and later uses linear-time regular expression matching for this pattern, while CRuby 3.1 and earlier and JRuby are affected. This issue is fixed in version 1.7.2.
CVE-2026-128068.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-128069.desc: rails-html-sanitizer is responsible for sanitizing HTML fragments in Rails applications. Before 1.7.2, the HTML4 and HTML5 variants of Rails::HTML::SafeListSanitizer reuse one Rails::HTML::PermitScrubber across calls and mutate its tags and attributes without synchronization. In a multithreaded process, concurrent sanitize calls using different tags: or attributes: options can interleave and cause one call to use the other call's allowlist. If a permissive call admits a script element or event-handler attribute, output expected to be sanitized under a stricter policy can retain it and cause cross-site scripting when rendered. Applications that are single-threaded, use one identical allowlist everywhere, or provide a separate scrubber: are not affected. This issue is fixed in version 1.7.2.
CVE-2026-128069.path: remote, no login, needs user action

CVE-2026-128070.desc: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. From 3.5.0 until 4.6.4, Nuxt can choose a parent directory as the default workspaceDir in either of two cases: a stray parent lockfile when the project is outside a Git repository and has no workspace file above it, or a parent pnpm or Deno settings file that does not declare packages or a workspace, including when the project is inside a Git repository. When the development server is reachable from an untrusted network, Vite permits /_nuxt/@fs/ requests beneath that widened directory, allowing unauthenticated clients to read files such as credentials and SSH keys. The issue affects the development server only; production builds and projects whose parent directories contain no qualifying files are unaffected. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.4.
CVE-2026-128070.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-128071.desc: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. Nuxt from 3.0.0 until 4.6.4, @nuxt/nitro-server from 3.20.0 until 4.6.4, and @nuxt/vite-server from 4.6.0 until 4.6.4, routeRules matching leaves an encoded slash (%2F) in the request path while a catch-all page such as app/pages/[...slug].vue or a custom multi-segment page route decodes it into a route parameter. The getRouteRules result is therefore incomplete, and an unauthenticated request can render the page without the redirect, headers, proxy, SSR, noScripts, appMiddleware, or appLayout rules configured for the decoded path. Protected content is resolved only when the page interprets the decoded parameter accordingly: a custom multi-segment parameter can contain the decoded path, while a repeatable catch-all must join the slash-containing array element; route.path remains encoded and does not resolve that resource. Static pages, single-segment parameters, server/api handlers, and server/routes handlers are not affected because they do not have the same encoded-path mismatch. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.4.
CVE-2026-128071.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-128072.desc: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. From @nuxt/webpack-builder 3.0.0 and @nuxt/rspack-builder 3.12.2 until 4.6.4, the development middleware trusts Origin, Referer, or Sec-Fetch-Site when the Host header names the same attacker-controlled hostname. After DNS rebinding changes that hostname to a loopback address, a malicious page opened by a developer can read /_nuxt/*.js client chunks and inline source maps, exposing compiled application source, local filesystem paths, and developer-controlled values embedded in the client bundle. The attacker must know or guess the development-server port and induce the developer to open the malicious page; Chrome 142 and later and other Chromium-based browsers that enforce Local Network Access restrictions prompt before a public page can reach the loopback address. The default Vite builder and production builds are unaffected. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.4.
CVE-2026-128072.path: remote, no login, needs user action

CVE-2026-128074.desc: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. From 4.6.0 until 4.6.4, _payload.json URL generation and the experimental early-404 path use a trailing-slash regular expression whose work grows quadratically with a long run of slash characters. An unauthenticated request can synchronously occupy the Node.js event loop and delay other requests when server-side rendering uses isr, swr, or cache route rules, or when experimental.early404 is enabled. Applications without those route rules and without experimental.early404, fully prerendered applications, and client-only applications are unaffected; the impact is limited to availability. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.4.
CVE-2026-128074.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-128075.desc: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. From 3.0.0 until 4.6.4, Nuxt wraps non-HTTP errors thrown during server rendering with createError and incorrectly treats the result as an error deliberately exposed by the application. In production, the error page payload (__NUXT_DATA__) and JSON error response can therefore disclose the original message and data, including an upstream $fetch URL, query-string secrets, response bodies, database hosts, or similar sensitive details, regardless of what a custom error.vue renders. Errors deliberately created with createError or showError, errors returned by useFetch or useAsyncData, and server/api routes are not affected because their client-visible behavior is intentional or follows a different path. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.4.
CVE-2026-128075.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-128076.desc: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. From 3.21.6 to before 4.0.0 and from 4.4.6 until 4.6.4, the /__nuxt_island path hash uses ohash serialization that does not escape quotes in string values or delimiters in object keys, allowing different island-prop tuples to produce the same path. For prerendering, substituted content is written into the generated page only if the crawler reaches a colliding URL before rendering the page with the legitimate props. Separately, a CDN or reverse proxy that keys island responses by path alone can be primed with the colliding response. If the substituted prop reaches v-html, innerHTML, or another unsafe HTML sink, the response can execute script in the application origin; otherwise the impact is content substitution. Applications that do not use server components or NuxtIsland, islands without attacker-influenced string props, and responses not cached by path alone are unaffected. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.4.
CVE-2026-128076.path: remote, no login, needs user action

CVE-2026-128077.desc: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. From 4.6.0 until 4.6.4, Nuxt parses a request path beginning with // as a URL host before rendering a page, while Nitro server/middleware and routeRules continue to evaluate the original path. An unauthenticated request such as //x/admin can therefore resolve to the /admin page without route-scoped serverHandlers, server/middleware path checks, redirects, or security headers configured for /admin. API handlers in server/api and server/routes, appMiddleware, page middleware are unaffected. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.4.
CVE-2026-128077.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-128078.desc: GLPI is a free asset and IT management software package. From 9.5.0 until 10.0.27 and 11.0.9, authenticated users could access ITIL followups, tasks, or solutions generated from templates without a read-permission check on the parent ticket, problem, or change. Depending on the template configuration, this could reveal information from parent items the user could not otherwise read. This issue is fixed in versions 10.0.27 and 11.0.9.
CVE-2026-128078.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-128079.desc: envd provides reproducible development environments for humans and agents. In versions starting with 0.3.38 and before 1.3.6, insufficient containment of host-side requirements-file reads in  install.python_packages(requirements=...)  could allow access to files outside the build context. An attacker able to influence build input could cause file contents interpreted as dependency entries to appear in debug logs or build-step metadata, subject to the envd process’s permissions. Exploitation in version 1.3.5 additionally requires concurrent modification of relevant filesystem paths. This issue is fixed in version 1.3.6.
CVE-2026-128079.path: local access needed, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-129139.title: paicoding commit b8206b9 through 903adce Predictable ZSXQ Account Credentials
CVE-2026-129139.desc: paicoding from commit b8206b9 through commit 903adce uses predictable credentials for accounts created via ZSXQ login, because loginByZsxq derives both the username and password solely from the member's ZSXQ number. Unauthenticated attackers can read that number from the victim's /user/{userId} profile page, compute the credentials, and log in via /login/username to take over the account.
CVE-2026-129139.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-129140.desc: paicoding 1.0.0 through 1.0.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in image upload because ImageServiceImpl.validateStaticImg accepts SVG files, which are then served from the site origin when local storage is used. Authenticated attackers can upload script-bearing SVG images that execute when victims view them, stealing the non-HttpOnly f-session cookie to hijack accounts.
CVE-2026-129140.path: remote, needs a user login, needs user action

CVE-2026-129141.desc: paicoding 1.0.0 through 1.0.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because SeoInjectService embeds user profile text without escaping in an inline JSON-LD script element. Authenticated attackers can add a closing script tag followed by HTML to their profile, executing scripts for visitors of their profile page and stealing the non-HttpOnly f-session cookie.
CVE-2026-129141.path: remote, needs a user login, needs user action

CVE-2026-129142.desc: paicoding commit 766c48b through commit 903adce contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in payment notifications, where NotifyMsgListener inserts the payer's display name unescaped and notify-system-item.html renders it via th:utext. Authenticated attackers can set a malicious display name and start a pending payment on a paid article, executing script in the author's browser when the author views notifications.
CVE-2026-129142.path: remote, needs a user login, needs user action

CVE-2026-129143.title: paicoding 1.0.3 Missing Authorization via Article Detail API Endpoint
CVE-2026-129143.desc: paicoding 1.0.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the ArticleRestController article detail endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to read restricted articles. Attackers can enumerate article IDs via GET /article/api/data/detail/{articleId} to retrieve full content of paid, login-only, member-only and draft articles.
CVE-2026-129143.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-129144.desc: paicoding 1.0.3 contains a payment bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to unlock paid articles by guessing weak payment confirmation codes. Attackers can start a payment, enumerate roughly 2000 IdUtil.genPayCode counter values, and submit the matching verifyCode to the unauthenticated callback to mark it paid.
CVE-2026-129144.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-129151.title: SurveyKing 1.13.2 Unauthenticated Survey Response Disclosure via Result Lookup
CVE-2026-129151.desc: SurveyKing 1.13.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in result lookup: the anonymous survey view leaks the lookup configuration, including its password, and the lookup password check is skipped when no answer is sent. Unauthenticated attackers with a public survey link can inject a % wildcard into the MyBatis LIKE condition to match all responses, then call loadProject with an answerId to read complete responses including hidden fields.
CVE-2026-129151.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-129152.desc: SurveyKing 1.12.0 through 1.13.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to submit survey responses because AnswerServiceImpl.saveAnswer skips login-required and survey password checks. Attackers can submit responses to protected surveys and set createBy in the request body to impersonate other users, corrupting survey results.
CVE-2026-129152.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-129153.title: SurveyKing 1.12.0 through 1.13.2 Authorization Bypass via Linked Survey linkSurveyId
CVE-2026-129153.desc: SurveyKing 1.12.0 through 1.13.2 contains an authorization bypass in the linked survey feature that fails to verify the referenced linkSurveyId belongs to the caller's own project. Authenticated attackers can point a linked option at another user's survey so that loadLinkResult and updateLinkSurveyAnswer read, rewrite, or create responses in that survey.
CVE-2026-129153.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-129154.desc: SurveyKing 1.13.0 through 1.13.2 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because the server accepts a respondent-supplied survey snapshot and the frontend renders its titles via innerHTML. Anonymous respondents can submit a forged snapshot embedding event handlers such as img onerror that execute in an administrator's browser session when the response is viewed.
CVE-2026-129154.path: remote, no login, needs user action

CVE-2026-129155.desc: DjangoBlog 2.0.0.0 through 2.1.0.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because the class_filter comment sanitizer passes event-handler attributes on span, div, pre and code tags. Authenticated commenters can post a div with autofocus and onfocus attributes, executing script without interaction for every visitor, including administrators.
CVE-2026-129155.path: remote, needs a user login, needs user action

CVE-2026-129156.desc: DjangoBlog commit d186b1c through commit 6134ed6 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated OAuth users to inject script via an unescaped nickname in comment reactions. Attackers can set their OAuth display name to a payload closing the single-quoted data-reactions attribute, then react to a comment to execute script in article visitors' browsers.
CVE-2026-129156.path: remote, needs a user login, needs user action

CVE-2026-129157.desc: ragent 1.0.0 through 1.1.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in RagTraceController that allows any logged-in user to view all users' RAG traces. Attackers can page through /rag/traces/runs and related node endpoints to read other users' usernames, user ids, conversation ids, questions, and per-node execution details.
CVE-2026-129157.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-129158.desc: ragent 1.1.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject scripts by uploading SVG knowledge-base documents served inline as image/svg+xml. Attackers can upload a script-bearing SVG via /knowledge-base/{kb-id}/docs/upload so that victims opening /knowledge-base/docs/{docId}/file execute it in the application origin, enabling account takeover.
CVE-2026-129158.path: remote, needs a user login, needs user action

CVE-2026-129160.desc: free-fs 2.0.1 through 2.3.1 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in FileShareServiceImpl.getPages, which passes the orderBy parameter of the /apis/share/pages endpoint verbatim into the ORDER BY clause via MyBatis-Flex without a column whitelist. Authenticated users can supply CASE WHEN subquery expressions that use share ordering as a boolean oracle to read arbitrary database contents, such as share codes.
CVE-2026-129160.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-129161.title: Dromara free-fs 2.0.1 through 2.3.1 Password Reset Code Brute-Force Account Takeover
CVE-2026-129161.desc: Dromara free-fs 2.0.1 through 2.3.1 contains an improper restriction of authentication attempts vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to brute-force six-digit password reset codes via PUT /apis/user/forget-password. Attackers can request a code for a known email and submit unlimited guesses during its 300-second lifetime to set a chosen password and take over the account.
CVE-2026-129161.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-129162.desc: Dromara free-fs 2.0.1 through 2.3.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in FileStreamController.preview that allows unauthenticated attackers to download stored files. Attackers who obtain a file ID from share listings or preview links can request /api/file/stream/preview/{fileId} to download any user's or workspace's files.
CVE-2026-129162.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-129163.desc: Dromara free-fs 2.0.1 through 2.3.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows registered users to run script by uploading HTML files served inline as text/html. Attackers can send a victim the /api/file/stream/preview/{fileId} link to execute script in the application origin, calling /apis endpoints to expose the victim's files and account.
CVE-2026-129163.path: remote, needs a user login, needs user action

CVE-2026-129164.desc: Dromara free-fs 2.0.1 through 2.3.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to access code-protected shares because share codes are enforced only client-side. CVE-2026-68551.title: Budget Board's OIDC login links to an existing local account by email alone, with no email_verified check, enabling account takeover of pre-existing users
CVE-2026-68551.desc: Budget Board is an app for tracking monthly spending and working towards financial goals. Prior to version 3.6.2, Budget Board's OIDC login flow finds and signs into an existing local account purely by matching the email address asserted in the identity provider's token - it never checks the standard email_verified claim. If the configured OIDC provider ever allows a user to register or display an email address without proving they own it , an attacker can register there using a victim's email and get signed into the victim's existing Budget Board account - including all their linked bank data. CVE-2026-68905.title: Hugo Blog: Unauthenticated AI Proxy Allows Abuse of Server-Side API Key
CVE-2026-68905.desc: Hugo Blog is a tech blog site. In commit 744ca15 and prior, the AI assistant proxy exposes three HTTP endpoints (POST /api/blog-assistant, POST /api/blog-search-embedding, POST /api/blog-search-rerank) without any authentication check. When deployed following the documented Nginx reverse-proxy setup, any unauthenticated remote attacker can send arbitrary requests that the proxy forwards to the upstream LLM/embedding/rerank API using the operator's server-side API key (OPENAI_API_KEY / AI_SEARCH_API_KEY). This enables unlimited quota consumption, cost exhaustion, and potential service unavailability for the operator. At time of publication, there are no publicly available patches.

CVE-2026-128124.title: AIOHTTP: Event loop stall in add_domain() wildcard matching
CVE-2026-128124.desc: AIOHTTP is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. Prior to 3.14.4, Application.add_domain() converts every asterisk wildcard in a domain mask into a greedy regular-expression fragment, so a mask containing two or more wildcards can take polynomial time to reject a long Host header that does not match. A remote attacker can repeatedly send such headers to a server configured with a multi-wildcard domain mask and stall the event loop. This issue is fixed in version 3.14.4.
CVE-2026-128124.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-128125.desc: AIOHTTP is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. Prior to 3.14.4, Set-Cookie parsing treats unrecognized name=value attributes as additional cookies, while CookieJar does not limit the number of cookies stored or sent. A malicious server can make an aiohttp client accumulate a very large cookie set, consume memory and CPU repeatedly across redirects, and construct an excessively large Cookie header for later requests to the same domain. This issue is fixed in version 3.14.4.
CVE-2026-128125.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-128126.title: AIOHTTP: Too many URL-encoded form fields block the event loop
CVE-2026-128126.desc: AIOHTTP is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. Prior to 3.14.4, Request.post() does not limit the number of fields in a URL-encoded form body, and inserting many repeated keys into MultiDict takes quadratic time on the event loop. A remote attacker can send a form POST within client_max_size to a handler that calls Request.post() and block the event loop. This issue is fixed in version 3.14.4.
CVE-2026-128126.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-128127.title: AIOHTTP: Base64 multipart parts bypass client_max_size
CVE-2026-128127.desc: AIOHTTP is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. Prior to 3.14.4, BodyPartReader.read_chunk() processing a multipart part with Content-Transfer-Encoding set to base64 keeps reading until the chunk length is a multiple of four without enforcing a byte limit. A short Content-Length or a long run of whitespace can cause one call to read the remaining body into memory before the size check or spin on the event loop. A remote attacker can send such a multipart request to a handler that reads multipart data and bypass client_max_size. This issue is fixed in version 3.14.4.
CVE-2026-128127.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-128128.title: AIOHTTP: WebSocket max_msg_size bypass via integer overflow
CVE-2026-128128.desc: AIOHTTP is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. Prior to 3.14.4, the C WebSocket reader adds a declared frame length to the size of an already buffered partial message using signed 64-bit arithmetic. A length near two to the power of 63 can overflow, allowing the max_msg_size check to pass. A remote peer can send a small non-final fragment followed by an oversized message and cause unbounded memory consumption. The Python WebSocket reader is unaffected. This issue is fixed in version 3.14.4.
CVE-2026-128128.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-128129.title: AIOHTTP: Unbounded buffering of data received during an upgrade request
CVE-2026-128129.desc: AIOHTTP is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. Prior to 3.14.4, aiohttp buffers all additional connection data received while a request marked for upgrade, such as a WebSocket handshake, is being handled, without a size limit or flow control. A remote attacker can stream data behind an upgrade request to a handler that does not immediately accept or reject the upgrade and cause unbounded memory consumption. This issue is fixed in version 3.14.4.
CVE-2026-128129.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-128130.title: AIOHTTP: Pure-Python parser request replay and buffer growth behind a declined upgrade
CVE-2026-128130.desc: AIOHTTP is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. Prior to 3.14.4, when the pipelined request queue is full, the pure-Python parser stores the unparsed remainder internally and also returns the same data to its caller. After a handler declines an upgrade request, the caller feeds the remainder back to the parser, causing the buffer to grow with each handled request and dispatching already-handled requests to the application again. The issue affects deployments using AIOHTTP_NO_EXTENSIONS or otherwise running without the standard C-extension wheel, and can cause excessive memory use and repeated request processing. This issue is fixed in version 3.14.4.
CVE-2026-128130.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-128131.title: AIOHTTP: Concatenated compressed streams cause excessive CPU use
CVE-2026-128131.desc: AIOHTTP is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. Prior to 3.14.4, aiohttp decompresses each member of a payload containing many concatenated gzip, deflate, or zstd streams by passing the entire remaining input to a new decompressor, causing quadratic CPU use. Empty members produce no output, so client_max_size and output backpressure do not limit the work. A remote attacker can block a server event loop with a crafted compressed request body or WebSocket message, and a malicious server can similarly block a client. This issue is fixed in version 3.14.4.
CVE-2026-128131.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-128132.title: AIOHTTP: WebSocket receive queue limits bypassed by small or compressed messages
CVE-2026-128132.desc: AIOHTTP is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. Prior to 3.14.4, the WebSocket reader continues parsing frames already received after the receive queue pauses the transport, and empty messages are not counted toward the queue size. With permessage-deflate, one read of compressed frames can add many megabytes of decompressed messages to the receive queue. A remote peer can send many small or compressed messages faster than the application consumes them and cause excessive memory use in a server or client. This issue is fixed in version 3.14.4.
CVE-2026-128132.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-126697.desc:
The Quick Page/Post Redirect Plugin WordPress plugin before 5.2.4 was distributed with a hidden update mechanism that fetched Quick Page/Post Redirect Plugin WordPress plugin before 5.2.4 updates from its author's own server instead of WordPress.org, which was used to push a backdoored build to sites, allowing the attacker controlling that server to inject arbitrary content into pages and to deliver arbitrary code to affected sites.

Version 5.2.1, as published on WordPress.org, bundled the Quick Page/Post Redirect Plugin WordPress plugin before 5.2.4 Update Checker library (updater/ directory) configured to poll https://anadnet.com/updates/?action=get_metadata&slug=quick-pagepost-redirect-Quick Page/Post Redirect Plugin WordPress plugin before 5.2.4. In March 2021 that server delivered a modified 5.2.3 build, different from the 5.2.3 later published on WordPress.org, which kept the update channel and added a the_content filter that, for logged-out visitors on single posts and pages, fetched content from https://w.anadnet.com/bro/3/ (passing the site host, request URI and visitor User-Agent) and prepended the response to the post (observed serving SEO spam links to search engine crawlers). Because the version string matched a later WordPress.org release, affected sites were not offered a clean update until 5.2.4.

Indicators of compromise:
- Outbound requests to anadnet.com or w.anadnet.com
- An updater/ directory (Quick Page/Post Redirect Plugin WordPress plugin before 5.2.4 Update Checker, Puc v4p10) inside wp-content/Quick Page/Post Redirect Plugin WordPress plugin before 5.2.4/quick-pagepost-redirect-Quick Page/Post Redirect Plugin WordPress plugin before 5.2.4/
- The strings filter_the_content_in_the_main_loop, ppr_pro, QQQEND or w.anadnet.com in page_post_redirect_Quick Page/Post Redirect Plugin WordPress plugin before 5.2.4.php
- page_post_redirect_Quick Page/Post Redirect Plugin WordPress plugin before 5.2.4.php with MD5 ad717da18cf8a2b69899c0d7dafee05a (tampered 5.2.3)

Remediation: remove the Quick Page/Post Redirect Plugin WordPress plugin before 5.2.4 (it has been closed on WordPress.org), or at minimum reinstall the clean 5.2.4 from WordPress.org, delete any leftover updater/ directory, verify the files with "wp Quick Page/Post Redirect Plugin WordPress plugin before 5.2.4 verify-checksums quick-pagepost-redirect-Quick Page/Post Redirect Plugin WordPress plugin before 5.2.4", clear the opcode cache, and treat any site that ran the tampered build as potentially compromised.
CVE-2026-126697.path: remote, no login, needs user action

CVE-2026-129319.desc: create-ecdh is a browserifiable implementation of Node.js crypto.createECDH. In versions 4.0.4 and below, the JavaScript implementation (browser.js, used by browser bundlers and on Node.js versions without a working native crypto.createECDH) did not validate peer public keys in ECDH.prototype.computeSecret or ECDH.prototype.setPublicKey. The peer point was multiplied by the local private key without checking that it was on the configured curve or in its prime-order subgroup. An attacker who can submit public keys to a party that reuses a static private key can perform an invalid-curve or small-subgroup attack and recover the private key modulo small factors, eventually recovering the full key via the Chinese Remainder Theorem. For the ed25519 and curve25519 curves, low-order points were also accepted, which could force a predictable shared secret. On modern Node.js, create-ecdh re-exports the native implementation, which is not affected. This issue is fixed in version 4.0.5.
CVE-2026-129319.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-124536.title: JSON::XS versions before 4.05 for Perl allow memory exhaustion by buffering incremental input past max_size after a NUL byte in incr_parse
CVE-2026-124536.desc:
JSON::XS versions before 4.05 for Perl allow memory exhaustion by buffering incremental input past max_size after a NUL byte in incr_parse.

The parser appends each chunk to its buffer and compares max_size with how far it has progressed, not with the buffer length. It treats a NUL byte as the end of the input, so a NUL within the first max_size bytes keeps it short of the limit. The buffer keeps growing, and incr_skip cannot remove the NUL.

A peer streaming data to an incr_parse consumer can exhaust process memory regardless of max_size.
CVE-2026-124536.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-124539.title: JSON::XS versions before 4.05 for Perl leak the decoded key of an object rejected for a missing colon in decode_hv
CVE-2026-124539.desc:
JSON::XS versions before 4.05 for Perl leak the decoded key of an object rejected for a missing colon in decode_hv.

Unless it is short plain ASCII, a quoted key is decoded into a new scalar. Nothing frees that scalar when the object is rejected for a missing ':' after the key.

A process that keeps running after a failed decode retains one key per rejected document, with its size chosen by the sender. Repeated requests exhaust process memory.
CVE-2026-124539.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-124540.title: JSON::XS versions before 4.05 for Perl allow stack exhaustion via nested tagged values under allow_tags in decode_tag
CVE-2026-124540.desc:
JSON::XS versions before 4.05 for Perl allow stack exhaustion via nested tagged values under allow_tags in decode_tag.

With allow_tags, "(" starts a tagged value. Its tag and value are decoded recursively, and each can start another tagged value. Unlike arrays and objects, this nesting is not counted against max_depth.

A run of "(" bytes exhausts the C stack and triggers an uncatchable segmentation fault regardless of max_depth.
CVE-2026-124540.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-124541.title: JSON::XS versions before 4.05 for Perl leak the decoded part of a rejected long string in decode_str
CVE-2026-124541.desc:
JSON::XS versions before 4.05 for Perl leak the decoded part of a rejected long string in decode_str.

A string is decoded through a fixed-size buffer (16 KiB in 4.04), and each time the buffer fills its contents move into a new scalar. Nothing frees that scalar when the string is then rejected for a control character, an invalid escape, malformed UTF-8 or the end of the input.

A process that keeps running after a failed decode retains the decoded part of each rejected string, with its size chosen by the sender. Repeated requests exhaust process memory.
CVE-2026-124541.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-129113.title: JSON::XS versions from 4.0_00 before 4.05 for Perl corrupt the incremental buffer length by chopping past its end in incr_skip after a top-level number
CVE-2026-129113.desc:
JSON::XS versions from 4.0_00 before 4.05 for Perl corrupt the incremental buffer length by chopping past its end in incr_skip after a top-level number.

The incremental parser scans any run of digits, signs, dots and exponent markers as one number, but the decoder stops at the end of a valid number, so the parser keeps an offset into bytes it has not decoded. It then empties the buffer without clearing those bytes, and a later incr_parse call without new input reads them again and moves the offset past the end of the buffer. incr_skip, the documented recovery after an error, removes that many bytes and the buffer length wraps.

A peer sending input such as "1-2" to an incr_parse consumer can make the next read of incr_text exit the process through perl's uncatchable out-of-memory path.
CVE-2026-129113.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-129114.title: JSON::XS versions from 3.04 before 4.05 for Perl write one byte past a heap buffer when appending a one-byte chunk in incr_parse
CVE-2026-129114.desc:
JSON::XS versions from 3.04 before 4.05 for Perl write one byte past a heap buffer when appending a one-byte chunk in incr_parse.

The incremental buffer grows to one and a half times the length it must hold, with no room reserved for the terminating NUL. For an empty buffer and a one-byte chunk that request is one byte, which a buffer whose front was removed by earlier decodes can already have, so nothing is reallocated and the NUL lands one byte past the allocation.

A peer streaming data to an incr_parse consumer, choosing how the input is split into reads, can cause a one-byte heap out-of-bounds write.
CVE-2026-129114.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-129115.title: JSON::XS versions from 3.0 before 4.05 for Perl read freed stack memory when a FREEZE result's serialisation grows the Perl stack under allow_tags in encode_rv
CVE-2026-129115.desc:
JSON::XS versions from 3.0 before 4.05 for Perl read freed stack memory when a FREEZE result's serialisation grows the Perl stack under allow_tags in encode_rv.

With allow_tags, an object's FREEZE method is called in list context and each returned value is encoded through a saved Perl stack pointer. When encoding a returned value calls back into Perl, through TO_JSON under convert_blessed or another FREEZE, and that callback grows the stack, the stack is reallocated while the saved pointer still refers to the freed block.

Encoding such objects reads freed memory, and encode can return undef without an error.
CVE-2026-129115.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-129456.title: frr: bgpd use-after-free of Tunnel Encapsulation sub-TLVs via the attribute intern reuse cache with soft-reconfiguration inbound
CVE-2026-129456.desc: In FRRouting, bgpd frees the sub-TLV chain of a Tunnel Encapsulation attribute (type 23) while routes stored by bgpd still point to it, if the attribute is received from a neighbor that has "soft-reconfiguration inbound" configured. A cache added to speed up attribute interning while processing the prefixes of an UPDATE checks whether an interned attribute set may be reused by comparing the parsed attributes with themselves, so the check always succeeds. Interning the parsed attributes for the Adj-RIB-In removes the Tunnel Encapsulation sub-TLVs from them, and the copy that bgpd then interns for the route reuses the cached attribute set, which still holds the sub-TLVs, without taking a reference on them. When the route is later replaced, withdrawn or cleared, for example when the session goes down, the sub-TLV chain is freed while still in use, and bgpd then reads it, decrements a reference count inside it and frees it a second time. In the reporter's build without AddressSanitizer this ended in an assertion failure in bgpd's memory accounting, aborting bgpd and dropping all BGP sessions on the router, and the neighbor can repeat it each time bgpd restarts. Because freed heap memory is written to and freed again, consequences beyond a crash cannot be ruled out. An established BGP session is required, and the attribute does not need to be malformed. bgpd processes attribute 23 from every neighbor, including eBGP neighbors, unless it is explicitly discarded, although RFC 9012 requires it to be filtered on eBGP sessions by default. Neighbors without "soft-reconfiguration inbound" are not affected.
CVE-2026-129456.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-129349.title: Apache Shiro: DefaultLdapRealm accepts any password when authentication caching is enabled
CVE-2026-129349.desc:
When authentication caching is enabled on DefaultLdapRealm, after a user logs in successfully once, subsequent logins for that user succeed with any password.
A cached authentication skips the LDAP bind, and the AllowAllCredentialsMatcher installed by default in DefaultLdapRealm accepts any credentials, allowing an attacker who knows a valid username to authenticate as that user.
This issue affects all Apache Shiro versions through 3.0.0, only when using DefaultLdapRealm (or JndiLdapRealm) with authenticationCachingEnabled set to true, which is not the default.

Mitigation: Upgrade to version 3.0.1 or later, which fixes the issue by no longer installing AllowAllCredentialsMatcher by default.
Alternatively, disable authentication caching on the LDAP realm (this is the default), or configure a credentials matcher, such as SimpleCredentialsMatcher, that verifies credentials against the cached authentication info.
CVE-2026-129349.path: remote, no login, no user action
