CVE-2026-110009.title: Unzer Payments <= 2.2.1 - Unauthenticated Authentication Bypass to Account Takeover via 'paymentData.email' Parameter
CVE-2026-110009.desc: The Unzer Payments plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass leading to Account Takeover in all versions up to, and including, 2.2.1. The vulnerability exists because the Google Pay Express Checkout endpoint (`/?wc-api=google_pay_express`), handled by `startCheckoutDataWithNormalizedCustomerData`, accepts an attacker-controlled `paymentData.email` value and passes it to `createOrGetGuestCustomer()`, which resolves the submitted email to any existing WordPress user via `get_user_by('email', ...)` and then calls `wp_set_current_user()` and `wp_set_auth_cookie()` for the resolved user ID without verifying ownership of the email address, a password, a nonce, an authentication token, or any proof of payment from the payment provider. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to log in as any existing WordPress user — including administrators — by submitting that user's known email address, receiving valid `wordpress_logged_in_*` session cookies for the targeted account and achieving full site takeover. The endpoint is entirely unprotected with no capability check, nonce validation, or payment-provider signature verification applied, and administrator email addresses are frequently discoverable via the WordPress REST API user enumeration endpoint (`/wp-json/wp/v2/users`), author archive pages, Gravatar lookups, or site contact footers.
CVE-2026-110009.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-110811.title: Trust Payments Gateway for WooCommerce (JavaScript Library) <= 1.3.8 - Unauthenticated Authentication Bypass to Administrator via Guest-Registration WP_Error Coercion
CVE-2026-110811.desc: The Trust Payments Gateway for WooCommerce (JavaScript Library) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass in all versions up to, and including, 1.3.8. The vulnerability exists because the `new_customer_account()` function stores the raw return value of `wp_create_user()` — including a `WP_Error` object returned on username collision — into the order's `tp_userid` post meta before the `is_wp_error()` guard is evaluated; the `add_customer_details_to_thankyou_page()` callback subsequently reads that meta and casts it with `(int)`, causing PHP to coerce any object to integer `1`, after which `wp_set_current_user(1)` and `wp_set_auth_cookie(1)` are called unconditionally. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to authenticate as WordPress user ID 1 — the bootstrap site administrator or, on multisite, a network super-admin — by supplying the `new_username` parameter matching any existing login during checkout and visiting the resulting thank-you page. Exploitation requires the Trust Payments gateway to be active and the attacker to complete a paid order on their own account; the ID 1 administrator username is additionally enumerable via standard WordPress user enumeration techniques.
products: Trust Payments Gateway for WooCommerce (JavaScript Library)
CVE-2026-110811.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-115814.desc: The Kirki – Freeform Page Builder, Website Builder & Customizer plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment (title attribute of <abbr>)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.4.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.
CVE-2026-115814.path: remote, no login, needs user action

CVE-2026-122042.desc: WarehousePG (WHPG) 6.27.1 through 6.27.7 and 7.2.1 through 7.6.1 are affected by an out-of-bounds write vulnerability (CWE-787) in gpfdist, the file server used to load and unload external tables. CVE-2026-95823.title: Use-after-free and net_buf leak in Zephyr TCP header linearization (tcp_pkt_linearize)
CVE-2026-95823.desc:
tcp_pkt_linearize() in subsys/net/ip/tcp.c is used by th_get() whenever a received TCP header is not contiguous in a single net_buf. While pulling the header bytes out of the following fragments, the loop called net_buf_unref() on an emptied fragment without first detaching its frags pointer. net_buf_unref() walks the whole fragment list, so the payload buffers still linked behind that fragment were freed as well, and the stale pointer was then reinstalled into the packet as buf->frags, producing a use-after-free and a later double free during packet teardown. The same loop also advanced to second->frags unconditionally: when the fragment still held payload after the header remainder was pulled, it was spliced out of the packet without ever being unreferenced, permanently leaking that buffer and silently dropping the data it carried.

The defect is reached from tcp_recv() via th_get() on every received TCP segment, before connection lookup or any header validation, so a single unauthenticated segment that matches a listening socket is sufficient. An attacker only needs the TCP header to straddle a net_buf boundary, which they can arrange from off-link: IPv6 extension headers are accepted on receive and their length is added to the header offset by th_get(), so a Destination Options header of a suitable length places the TCP header across the boundary of the fixed-size receive buffers (CONFIG_NET_BUF_DATA_SIZE). Packet chains assembled from several sources - IPv4/IPv6 reassembly, 6LoWPAN/802.15.4 reassembly, tunnel or virtual interfaces that strip an outer header, or drivers producing scatter-gather chains - can additionally present a short interior fragment that the loop empties exactly, which is the case that frees the remainder of the packet while it is still in use.

The reliably reachable consequence is exhaustion of the receive buffer pool: each crafted segment leaks one net_buf from the fixed CONFIG_NET_BUF_RX_COUNT pool, the buffers are never reclaimed, and once the pool is empty the device can no longer receive network traffic until it is rebooted. Where a fragment is emptied exactly, the impact rises to memory corruption: freed pool buffers are written through by the remainder of the loop, their contents may be delivered to the application, and the packet is double-freed on teardown.

The fix saves and clears second->frags before the net_buf_unref() so only the emptied header fragment is released, and advances to the next fragment only when second->len == 0, keeping any fragment that still holds payload in the packet. This restores the detach-before-unref ownership pattern used elsewhere in the stack, for example in net_pkt_trim_buffer().

CVE-2026-126721.title: Magic Login Mail or QR Code <= 2.07 - Unauthenticated Privilege Escalation via Account Takeover to Host Header Injection in curpageurl() Magic-Login URL
CVE-2026-126721.desc: The Magic Login Mail or QR Code plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation via Administrator Account Takeover in versions up to, and including, 2.07. This is due to the `curpageurl()` function falling back to the raw `$_SERVER['HTTP_HOST']` value — with no validation against the site's configured origin via `home_url()` or `site_url()` — when `get_the_permalink()` returns empty or false, allowing an attacker-controlled Host header to become the URL origin of the magic-login link generated by `generate_url()` and delivered to the target via `wp_mail()`. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to intercept the one-time uid and token pair sent to a targeted Administrator's email and replay them against the real site, causing `autologin_via_url()` to call `wp_set_auth_cookie()` and establish a full Administrator session on the targeted account. Exploitation requires the `[magic_login]` shortcode to render on a path where `get_the_permalink()` returns empty or false (such as a 404 page or a block-theme header template part), the web server to forward non-canonical Host headers, the attacker to know the target administrator's email address, and the administrator to click the attacker-originated magic-login link. Successful exploitation gives the attacker control of a distinct, already-privileged Administrator account; it does not promote the attacker's original account. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.
products: Magic Login Mail or QR Code
CVE-2026-126721.path: remote, no login, needs user action

CVE-2026-71861.title: Chainguard SDK: AWS SigV4 token replay in auth/aws.VerifyToken — Chainguard-Audience/Chainguard-Identity binding headers not required in SignedHeaders

CVE-2026-130007.title: k8s-mcp-server: Missing authentication on default SSE/HTTP transport allows unauthenticated Kubernetes tool execution
CVE-2026-130007.desc: k8s-mcp-server manages Kubernetes clusters through the Model Context Protocol. Prior to 1.1.0, SERVER_MODE defaults to SSE, with the listener on 0.0.0.0:8080, but main.go creates the SSE server without an authentication option or context function. The GET /sse handler creates a sessionId that is only a correlation value, and the POST /message handler accepts a loadable sessionId without an authorization or Origin check before dispatching tools/call; consequently, any client able to reach the port can enumerate and invoke registered Kubernetes tools without credentials. Read-only mode is disabled by default, leaving write-capable Kubernetes tools available to run with the server's configured cluster privileges. This issue is fixed in version 1.1.0.

CVE-2026-130008.title: sqlite-mcp: Read-only mode bypass via statement chaining and SQL injection in describe_table
CVE-2026-130008.desc: sqlite-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server for SQLite. Prior to 0.1.2, the default read-only mode can be bypassed through execute_query, which accepts a leading SELECT while the SQLite driver executes trailing statements, and through describe_table, which interpolates the caller-controlled table_name into PRAGMA table_info. Either path can issue ATTACH DATABASE, which opens an attached file read-write despite mode=ro and can make the protected database writable, read other SQLite database files, or create a SQLite-format file at a path writable by the server process. Existing non-empty files that are not SQLite databases are refused and left unchanged. The server has no built-in authentication and listens on all interfaces at :8080 by default, so any client that can reach the port can invoke these tools unless an authenticating proxy is in place. This issue is fixed in version 0.1.2.
CVE-2026-130008.path: remote, no login, no user action

An unrestricted source_path can be copied into the vault and retrieved through secure_query, disclosing files readable by the service; files that do not match the executable-pattern filter pass that filter. When ENABLE_LEGACY_EXTENSIONS=true, zyrabit-slm/api-rag/app/main.py registers POST /mcp/rpc without get_current_user, allowing unauthenticated network tool calls; this optional exposure is disabled by default and is not required for local invocation. CVE-2026-130156.desc: Bazarr is a companion application to Sonarr and Radarr. Prior to 1.6.3-beta.11, the /api/subtitles/subtitles-info handler uses SubtitleNameContents.get() in subtitles_contents.py and reads the caller-supplied subtitlePath after checking only its subtitle extension; because the resolved path is not confined to files indexed by Bazarr, traversal can read files outside the media library. The /api/subtitles/subtitles handler in subtitles.py passes caller-supplied path and reference to sync and translation without per-path authorization, allowing an out-of-library reference file to be read and output to overwrite a file outside the media library. The authenticate decorator gates both endpoints when API authentication is enabled, while auth = None allows access without credentials. Both paths can affect only files that the Bazarr process can read or write. This issue is fixed in version 1.6.3-beta.11.
CVE-2026-130156.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-59159.title: Linux Mint Update Manager: Local Privilege Escalation in mint-refresh-cache
CVE-2026-59159.desc: Linux Mint Update Manager manages software updates on Linux Mint systems. From 5.4.8 until 5.5.4.3, 5.5.9.1, 5.8.8.1, 5.9.8.1, 6.0.9.1, and 6.1.5.1, mint-refresh-cache passes a user-controlled --parent-window-id value directly to the privileged Synaptic process without validating it as an integer. A local user permitted to execute mint-refresh-cache through sudo can inject additional Synaptic command-line options and achieve arbitrary code execution as root. This issue is fixed in versions 5.5.4.3, 5.5.9.1, 5.8.8.1, 5.9.8.1, 6.0.9.1, and 6.1.5.1.

CVE-2026-76411.desc:
A vulnerability in the phishcheck functionality of ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a DoS condition on an affected device.
 This vulnerability is due to improper allocation of memory during processing of URLs. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a URL to be processed by the software. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the ClamAV scanning process to terminate, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.
CVE-2026-76411.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-76414.desc:
A vulnerability in Microsoft Compiled HTML Help (CHM) file scanning of ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a DoS condition on an affected device.
 This vulnerability is due to a logic error when scanning the CHM file and following the internal file pointers. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted CHM file for scanning. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the ClamAV decode process to terminate due to an infinite loop, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.
CVE-2026-76414.path: remote, no login, no user action

A vulnerability in the Yoda'a Crytper (yC) Portable Executable (PE) unpacker of ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a DoS condition on an affected device. .
 This vulnerability is due to lack of proper error checking for negative values when processing the PE file to be unpacked. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a PE file to be unpacked. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the ClamAV scanning process to terminate, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.
CVE-2026-76415.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-76416.desc:
A vulnerability in the InstallShield file parser of ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a DoS condition on an affected device.
 This vulnerability is due to incomplete error checking when the InstallShield File Parser is performing a scan. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted InstallShield file to be scanned. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the ClamAV scanning process to terminate due to an infinite loop, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.
CVE-2026-76416.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-76417.desc:
A vulnerability in Object Linking and Embedding, 2nd Generation (OLE2) file parser for ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a DoS condition on an affected device.
 This vulnerability is due to logic error when parsing specifically formatted files with the OLE2 file parser. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by by sending a crafted Microsoft Compound File Binary (CFB) file to be scanned. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to allocate all available memory, causing the ClamAV scanning process to terminate, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.
CVE-2026-76417.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-76421.desc:
A vulnerability in the LZX data algorithm for Microsoft Compiled HTML Help (CHM) file scanning in ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a DoS condition on an affected device.
 This vulnerability is due to improper boundary checks when applying the LZX data algorithm to CHM files during the decoder stage, which may result in buffer overflow. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted CHM file for scanning. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the ClamAV scanning process to terminate, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.
CVE-2026-76421.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-76422.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-115622.desc: A flaw was found in ansible-core. The $currenturl variable in news-details.php is constructed using unencoded REQUEST_URI and HTTP_HOST server variables and echoed directly into the href attributes of social share links. An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this by crafting a URL containing HTML metacharacters to break out of the href attribute and execute arbitrary HTML or JavaScript in the context of the victim's browser.
CVE-2026-128666.path: remote, no login, needs user action

CVE-2026-130638.desc:
Relative path traversal in the object detection dataset preparation tool in AutoGluon Multimodal before 1.6.0 might allow adversary-in-the-middle attackers to write arbitrary files with the privileges of the user running the tool via a crafted dataset archive substituted for a dataset downloaded over plaintext HTTP.



To remediate this issue, users should upgrade autogluon.multimodal to version 1.6.0 or later.
CVE-2026-130638.path: remote, no login, needs user action

CVE-2026-130750.desc: Network-AI from 5.11.0 before 5.17.2 contains a CORS misconfiguration in McpStreamableServer that reflects localhost Origins into Access-Control-Allow-Origin regardless of bind interface. Attackers controlling a localhost-origin page or DNS-rebinding name can read unauthenticated /tools and /health responses, exposing tool catalogs and bridge metadata on non-loopback binds.
CVE-2026-130750.path: local access needed, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-130751.title: OpenWrt LuCI luci-app-travelmate before 3.0.0-1 and 2.4.9-6 Improper Access Control via Read ACL
CVE-2026-130751.desc: OpenWrt LuCI luci-app-travelmate on master before 3.0.0-1 and on openwrt-25.12 before 2.4.9-6 grants file exec permissions for state-mutating commands in the read scope of its rpcd ACL, letting authenticated read-only users run those commands as root. Attackers can invoke ubus file exec on /etc/init.d/travelmate setup, start, stop, restart, or /sbin/ifup to modify and commit network and firewall configuration or disrupt the travelmate daemon.
CVE-2026-130751.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130752.desc: OpenWrt LuCI luci-app-uhttpd before commit d38658bedbdd811b798da16b49301478c6cf21af grants '/*' file read in its rpcd read ACL, which rpcd's fnmatch matching applies to every path. Users delegated only luci-app-uhttpd read access can read any file as root, including /etc/shadow, /etc/config/* credentials, /etc/uhttpd.key, and /etc/dropbear keys.
CVE-2026-130752.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130753.title: heym before 0.0.142 Authenticated RCE via Playwright Step-Mode String Fields
CVE-2026-130753.desc: heym before 0.0.142 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the Playwright step-mode node where _resolve_expressions_in_code substitutes workflow values directly into generated Python source. Authenticated non-admin users can craft step field values that break out of string literals to execute arbitrary Python as root inside the backend container.
CVE-2026-130753.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130754.title: LaraDashboard Account Takeover via Unverified OAuth Email in SocialAuthService
CVE-2026-130754.desc: All versions of LaraDashboard contain an authentication bypass in SocialAuthService::findOrCreateUser(), which links a social login to an existing account by email without checking that the OAuth provider verified that email. Unauthenticated attackers using an OAuth/OIDC provider that asserts a victim's email can log in as any user, including Superadmin, and keep persistent access through a linked social_accounts entry.
CVE-2026-130754.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-130755.desc: Froxlor before 2.3.16 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated customers to read hidden traffic statistics by calling the Traffic.listing API command. Attackers can authenticate to api.php with their API key and secret to retrieve HTTP, FTP, and mail traffic volumes despite the panel.customer_hide_options restriction.
CVE-2026-130755.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130756.title: pnpm exe before 10.34.8 Trusts Compromised eMudhra Intermediate Certificates
CVE-2026-130756.desc: pnpm exe before 10.34.8 embeds an outdated Node.js runtime that still trusts compromised eMudhra intermediate CA certificates during registry TLS connections. Network attackers holding a recovered intermediate key can intercept standalone pnpm registry fetches and serve forged package metadata or tarballs.
CVE-2026-130756.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-130757.title: Fleet before 4.92.0 Case-Insensitive Security Token Comparison Account Takeover
CVE-2026-130757.desc: Fleet before 4.92.0 contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows attackers to reuse case-mutated security tokens because MySQL token columns used case-insensitive collation. Attackers holding a case-normalized invite or email-change token can redirect a victim's email for account takeover or redeem invites with roles up to Global Admin.
CVE-2026-130757.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-130758.title: Fleet before 4.92.0 Authorization Bypass via Deprecated Apple MDM Enqueue Endpoint
CVE-2026-130758.desc: Fleet before 4.92.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the deprecated POST /api/latest/fleet/mdm/apple/enqueue endpoint that allows team-scoped users to enqueue Apple MDM commands outside their teams. Attackers with team admin, maintainer, or GitOps roles can include one own-team host UUID alongside unresolved enrollment IDs to send commands like InstallProfile to deleted or user-channel enrollments without activity logging.
CVE-2026-130758.path: remote, needs admin rights, no user action

CVE-2026-130759.title: Fleet from 4.71.0 before 4.88.2 SAML SSO Authentication Bypass via Session Store Keys
CVE-2026-130759.desc: Fleet from 4.71.0 before 4.88.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the SAML SSO callback that looks up sessions using unvalidated client-supplied identifiers. Users able to run live queries or enroll secret holders can plant attacker-controlled identity provider metadata in the session store, then present a self-signed SAML response to log in as a global admin.
CVE-2026-130759.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130760.title: Fleet before 4.86.2 Unauthenticated DoS via Apple MDM PKCS#7 Parsing
CVE-2026-130760.desc: Fleet before 4.86.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server memory via unbounded BER recursion in PKCS#7 parsing. Attackers can send deeply nested indefinite-length structures to Apple MDM check-in, enrollment, SCEP, or OTA endpoints to crash the entire Fleet instance.
CVE-2026-130760.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-130761.title: Fleet before 4.92.0 Denial of Service via osquery Result Log Submission
CVE-2026-130761.desc: Fleet before 4.92.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows enrolled hosts to trigger unbounded per-name database lookups by submitting osquery result logs. Attackers with a valid host node key can send one request to /api/osquery/log containing many distinct query names, exhausting database connections and read replica capacity.
CVE-2026-130761.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-130762.desc: Fleet before 4.92.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated observer-level users to sort software listings by arbitrary columns via the order_key parameter. Attackers can order by joined hosts table columns such as node keys and use pagination as a binary-search oracle to extract sensitive column values.
CVE-2026-130762.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130763.desc: Fleet before 4.92.0 contains a CSV formula injection vulnerability in the host inventory export endpoint that allows attackers controlling an enrolled host or enroll secret to plant spreadsheet formulas. Attackers can set osquery-reported fields like hostname or hardware serial to formula values, enabling data exfiltration or DDE command execution when users open the exported CSV.
CVE-2026-130763.path: remote, needs a user login, needs user action

CVE-2026-130764.title: Obot 0.8.0 before 0.27.0 SSRF via OAuth Token Endpoint
CVE-2026-130764.desc: Obot from 0.8.0 before 0.27.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows Power User accounts to reach internal hosts by advertising a malicious OAuth token endpoint in remote MCP server metadata. Attackers can direct token exchange or refresh requests, including redirected GET requests, to cloud metadata services or private-network hosts and read error response bodies.
CVE-2026-130764.path: remote, needs admin rights, no user action

CVE-2026-130765.desc: Obot before 0.27.0 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass same-site validation of the rd parameter by inserting a tab character. Attackers can craft sign-in or sign-out links on the Obot domain that browsers resolve to external hosts, redirecting victims to phishing pages.
CVE-2026-130765.path: remote, no login, needs user action

CVE-2026-130766.title: Obot 0.26.0 before 0.27.0 Access Token Theft via OAuth Resource Metadata
CVE-2026-130766.desc: Obot from 0.26.0 before 0.27.0 fails to validate the resource identifier in remote MCP server protected resource metadata, allowing malicious MCP servers to steal access tokens. Attackers can name a different service and authorization server with chosen scopes, causing Obot to obtain the victim's token for that service and forward it to the attacker.
CVE-2026-130766.path: remote, no login, needs user action

CVE-2026-130767.desc: Obot from 0.9.0 before 0.27.0 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to execute shell commands by embedding an EOF line in file-type MCP server configuration values. Attackers can terminate the heredoc in the generated init container script to run commands, modify the MCP server files volume, and reach services on Obot's Docker network.
CVE-2026-130767.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130768.desc: Obot from 0.14.0 before 0.27.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows Power Users to bypass outbound protections by supplying unspecified addresses, IPv6 transition addresses, or registry icon URLs. Attackers can add remote MCP servers pointing to 0.0.0.0, ::, or NAT64/6to4/Teredo addresses embedding blocked IPv4 addresses to probe internal services for reachability.
CVE-2026-130768.path: remote, needs admin rights, no user action

CVE-2026-130769.desc: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows clients permitted to create instances to crash the daemon by importing a backup with a null snapshot entry in index.yaml. Attackers can trigger an unrecovered nil pointer dereference during configuration rewrite, terminating the daemon and all containers and virtual machines on the node.
CVE-2026-130769.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130770.title: Incus before 7.6.0 VM Disk Hijacking via Abstract NBD Unix Sockets
CVE-2026-130770.desc: Incus before 7.6.0 creates the NBD servers used for virtual machine migration and disk export on abstract unix sockets, which have no permission checks and whose names are visible in /proc/net/unix. A local unprivileged user can connect while an operation runs to read or modify the VM disk, gaining code execution in the guest on a migration's receiving side.
CVE-2026-130770.path: local access needed, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130771.title: Incus before 7.6.0 Host File Read/Overwrite via Backup or Image Metadata
CVE-2026-130771.desc: Incus before 7.6.0 fails to reject special files, hard links, or symlinks in backup or image metadata, allowing restricted project users to read or overwrite host files. Attackers can import crafted backups containing device nodes, a hard-linked backup.yaml, or symlinks to corrupt host storage, overwrite host files, or leak other projects' data.
CVE-2026-130771.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130772.desc: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows restricted TLS clients to read other projects' bucket S3 keys and profile configuration through recursive and all-projects responses. Attackers can query bucket listings with recursion=2 or profiles with all-projects=true to obtain S3 secret keys and sensitive environment, cloud-init and user values across projects.
CVE-2026-130772.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130773.title: Incus before 7.6.0 Project Isolation Bypass via Default Project Resource Creation
CVE-2026-130773.desc: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass that allows restricted project users to create resources in the unrestricted default project by targeting projects lacking features.* flags. Attackers can create bridge networks with raw.dnsmasq dhcp-script injection to run scripts as root, or custom volumes with block.create_options mkfs arguments to read host files.
CVE-2026-130773.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130774.title: Incus before 7.6.0 Privilege Escalation via Rebuild of Never-Started Container
CVE-2026-130774.desc: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability: rebuilding a never-started unprivileged container makes it boot without a user namespace. Root processes inside the container run as host uid 0, keeping capabilities like sys_module, with no device cgroup restriction, letting them load kernel modules and compromise the host.
CVE-2026-130774.path: local access needed, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130775.desc: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the /dev/incus guest-API image export handler that fails to pin the project parameter to the guest's own project. Container root users with the guest-API image entitlement can supply another project in the project query parameter to export public or cached images, including non-public images pulled from authenticated remotes.
CVE-2026-130775.path: local access needed, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130776.title: Incus before 7.6.0 Migration Hijack via Exposed Websocket Secrets
CVE-2026-130776.desc: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows clients with project event-view access to read migration websocket secrets broadcast in operation metadata. Attackers can connect to in-flight migration control and fs websockets before the legitimate peer, hijacking the transfer to obtain instance configuration and filesystem data.
CVE-2026-130776.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130777.desc: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows project-restricted authenticated clients to receive other projects' OVN ACL logs because these events are broadcast with an empty project. Attackers can subscribe to network-acl events on one accessible project to observe internal IPs, ports, protocols, and allow/drop decisions across all projects.
CVE-2026-130777.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130778.title: Incus before 7.6.0 Authentication Bypass via Unverified Client Certificate Chains
CVE-2026-130778.desc: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows remote attackers to authenticate as any trusted certificate by appending its public certificate to their presented TLS client chain. Attackers can append the server's or a cluster member's certificate to gain cluster-level access, bypass authorization, modify trust store entries, and influence scriptlet-based authorization decisions.
CVE-2026-130778.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-130779.title: Incus before 7.6.0 Path Traversal via Custom Volume Backup Snapshot Names
CVE-2026-130779.desc: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows users permitted to import custom volumes to store unvalidated snapshot names from the backup index configuration section. Attackers can craft a backup with traversal sequences in snapshot names so later deletion removes arbitrary host directories as root, while renaming or mounting operates on arbitrary paths.
CVE-2026-130779.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130780.title: Incus before 7.6.0 Path Traversal via Dependent Volumes in Migration
CVE-2026-130780.desc: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows malicious migration peers to write outside intended directories by supplying unvalidated dependent volume and snapshot names in the migration offer header. Attackers controlling a migration source can create root-owned volumes with attacker content at arbitrary host paths, compromising hosts using dir storage pools, bypassing restricted.storage-pools.access, or crashing the daemon.
CVE-2026-130780.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130781.desc: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in the storage bucket S3 listener, which buffers entire signed request bodies in memory before verifying the signature or credential role. Attackers knowing only a valid access key, or holding a read-only credential, can send many concurrent large requests to exhaust daemon memory.
CVE-2026-130781.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130782.title: Incus before 7.6.0 Improper Authorization Exposes Default Project Resources
CVE-2026-130782.desc: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows restricted and view-only clients to read default project resources by requesting the default project directly. Attackers knowing resource names can read profiles, images, network zone peer keys and stored credentials, and export custom volume or bucket backups to obtain full contents or S3 admin keys.
CVE-2026-130782.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130783.title: Incus before 7.6.0 Token Exposure and Missing Authorization via Operation Events
CVE-2026-130783.desc: Incus before 7.6.0 exposes certificate and cluster join token secrets through the default project event stream and skips authorization when cancelling operations without associated permissions. Restricted clients can subscribe to operation events to capture certificate tokens and enroll unrestricted certificates, gaining full server access, or cancel token operations by UUID.
CVE-2026-130783.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130784.title: Incus before 7.6.0 Authorization Bypass via Default Project Resource Inheritance
CVE-2026-130784.desc: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows restricted clients to create and access default project resources by exploiting entitlement checks against the requested project. Attackers can create bridge networks with raw.dnsmasq directives to execute code as root on the host, or manipulate inherited resources via the ?project= parameter.
CVE-2026-130784.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130785.title: Incus 7.3.0 before 7.6.0 Guest API Container Impersonation via Forged Cgroup
CVE-2026-130785.desc: Incus from 7.3.0 before 7.6.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the /dev/incus guest API that allows a process in one container to impersonate another by creating a cgroup named with a forged lxc.monitor. component. Attackers can read the target container's user.* and cloud-init.* configuration and devices, subscribe to its events, mark it ready, and export images across projects.
CVE-2026-130785.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130786.title: Incus before 7.6.0 LXC Configuration Injection via OCI Image Config
CVE-2026-130786.desc: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a configuration injection vulnerability that allows users who can launch instances from controlled images to inject LXC directives by embedding line breaks in OCI config.json values or oci.entrypoint and oci.cwd keys. Attackers can add liblxc hooks or crafted tmpfs lxc.mount.entry fields to run commands as root on the host or bind-mount host paths, even from restricted projects.
CVE-2026-130786.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130787.title: Frappe ERPNext before 16.35.0 Missing Authorization in Financial Reporting Endpoints
CVE-2026-130787.desc: Frappe ERPNext before 16.35.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in financial reporting endpoints that allows low-privilege authenticated users to generate reports outside their permitted scope. Attackers can send crafted requests to affected reporting endpoints to read other companies' tax and payment data, including personal and corporate identifiers and financial totals.
CVE-2026-130787.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130788.desc: SemanticMediaWiki from 3.0.0 before 7.4.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in CsvFileExportPrinter and DsvResultPrinter via unescaped valuesep and separator parameters. Attackers can craft Special:Ask links using request_type=special_page so export output renders as text/html, executing JavaScript in victims' browsers under the wiki origin.
CVE-2026-130788.path: remote, no login, needs user action

CVE-2026-130789.desc: SemanticMediaWiki from 7.3.0 before 7.4.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the smwtask API check-query task that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass object-level authorization by relying on the wiki-wide edit right. Attackers can supply arbitrary subject titles, including protected pages, to run synchronous Semantic MediaWiki queries with caller-controlled conditions, limit, offset, and querymode parameters.
CVE-2026-130789.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-130790.desc: SemanticMediaWiki from 2.5.0 before 7.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows users with the smw-patternedit right to inject script by seeding markup reference names in MediaWiki:Smw_allows_pattern. Once an editor annotates the matching Allows pattern value, AllowsPatternValue emits it unescaped on Special:Browse, executing JavaScript in every viewer's session.
CVE-2026-130790.path: remote, needs admin rights, needs user action

CVE-2026-130791.title: Finsys Dockhand before 1.0.55 Path Traversal via Stack Relocate oldDir Parameter
CVE-2026-130791.desc: Finsys Dockhand before 1.0.55 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows users with stacks:edit permission to move arbitrary server directories by supplying a crafted oldDir parameter. Attackers can send POST requests to /api/stacks/[name]/relocate with an unvalidated source path to relocate directories into stack paths, disrupting services and exposing their contents.
CVE-2026-130791.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-45142.title: Chamilo LMS: IDOR in lp_ajax_save_objectives.php — Attacker Can Overwrite Any User's SCORM Objectives via uid Parameter
CVE-2026-45142.desc: Chamilo LMS is an open-source learning management system. Prior to 1.11.40 and 2.0.1, main/lp/lp_ajax_save_objectives.php and public/main/lp/lp_ajax_save_objectives.php trust the request uid parameter instead of the authenticated user identity when saving SCORM learning objectives. Any authenticated student can replace uid with another user's identifier and overwrite that user's objectives because the endpoint performs no ownership check. This issue is fixed in versions 1.11.40 and 2.0.1.
CVE-2026-45142.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-54747.desc: Chamilo LMS is an open-source learning management system. Prior to 2.0.3, public/main/course_description/course_description_controller.php assigns contentDescription directly from a teacher's request in the Doctrine-based add and edit paths without cross-site scripting sanitization. The stored value is rendered by src/CoreBundle/Resources/views/Course/about.html.twig through description with raw output, and the /course/{id}/about route is publicly accessible. A teacher can store active content that executes when an authenticated or unauthenticated visitor views the course description, enabling session theft, credential phishing, defacement, or actions in an authenticated victim's session. This issue is fixed in version 2.0.3.
CVE-2026-54747.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-55503.desc: Chamilo LMS is an open-source learning management system. Prior to 1.11.40 and 2.0.3, main/lp/scormItem.class.php and public/main/lp/scormItem.class.php store an attacker-controlled title element from imsmanifest.xml without cross-site scripting sanitization when a teacher imports a SCORM package. The title reaches c_lp_item.title and is rendered by src/CoreBundle/Resources/views/LearnPath/scorm_list.html.twig through item.title with raw output while Twig auto-escaping is disabled; the default configuration does not apply the optional AI-disclosure sanitization path. Enrolled students or administrators who view the learning-path table of contents can execute the stored content in their browser sessions. This issue is fixed in versions 1.11.40 and 2.0.3.
CVE-2026-55503.path: remote, needs a user login, needs user action

CVE-2026-55504.desc: Chamilo LMS is an open-source learning management system. Prior to 2.0.3, POST /api/social_posts accepts attacker-controlled content that SocialPost::setContent stores without cross-site scripting sanitization, and assets/vue/components/social/SocialWallPost.vue renders post.content through v-html without sanitization. Any authenticated user can create a social-wall post that executes active content when another authenticated user views the wall. The script can run in an administrator's browser session and expose session data or perform actions with the victim's privileges. This issue is fixed in version 2.0.3.
CVE-2026-55504.path: remote, needs a user login, needs user action

CVE-2026-61528.title: Chamilo LMS: XXE Injection Vulnerability in BigBlueButton Plugin
CVE-2026-61528.desc: Chamilo LMS is an open-source learning management system. From 2.0.0 until 2.0.3, the BigBlueButton plugin is vulnerable to XML External Entity (XXE) injection when an authenticated administrator configures a malicious BigBlueButton server URL. Processing attacker-controlled XML from that server can read arbitrary local files and perform Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF). Sensitive configuration, credentials, source code, and internal network resources may be exposed. This issue is fixed in version 2.0.3.
CVE-2026-61528.path: remote, needs admin rights, no user action

CVE-2026-61532.title: Chamilo LMS: ZIP Slip / Path Traversal in CourseRestorer leads to arbitrary file write and RCE by any course teacher
CVE-2026-61532.desc: Chamilo LMS is an open-source learning management system. Prior to 1.11.40 and 2.0.3, src/Chamilo/CourseBundle/Component/CourseCopy/CourseRestorer.php and src/CourseBundle/Component/CourseCopy/CourseRestorer.php use paths supplied by an imported legacy course backup without consistently confining them to the extraction directory. A course teacher can import a crafted backup containing parent-directory path segments, causing file operations to write attacker-controlled content outside the intended destination, including PHP-executable or automatically loaded locations. This can result in code execution as the PHP process and compromise course data, user data, credentials, and the host. This issue is fixed in versions 1.11.40 and 2.0.3.
CVE-2026-61532.path: remote, needs a user login, needs user action

CVE-2026-61578.title: Chamilo LMS CleanDeletedFiles plugin permits arbitrary file deletion
CVE-2026-61578.desc: Chamilo LMS is an open-source learning management system. Prior to 1.11.40 on the 1.11 release line and in 2.0.0, plugin/cleandeletedfiles/src/ajax.php and public/plugin/CleanDeletedFiles/src/ajax.php pass the request path parameter and list parameter directly to unlink without canonicalization, filename validation, or confinement to the plugin's scanned directories. An authenticated administrator can delete arbitrary files writable by the web server; a cross-site request forgery against an administrator session can reach the same operation. Deleting application source, uploaded content, cache, or configuration files can cause data loss and denial of service. This issue is fixed in version 1.11.40 on the 1.11 release line. No fixed 2.0 release is established as of this review.
CVE-2026-61578.path: remote, needs admin rights, no user action

CVE-2026-61581.title: Datadog Agent: Datadog SSI Injector Contains Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
CVE-2026-61581.desc: The Datadog Agent collects events and metrics from hosts and sends them to Datadog. Prior to datadog-apm-inject 0.66.0, the Datadog Single Step Instrumentation injector stores helper tooling in a predictable host directory. On Linux or Kubernetes systems with SSI enabled and at least one Java service instrumented through SSI, a local unprivileged attacker with shell access to the same host can influence that tooling and execute code with the privileges of the instrumented Java service. Services that use dd-java-agent without SSI and non-Java language runtimes are not affected. This issue is fixed in datadog-apm-inject 0.66.0.
CVE-2026-61581.path: local access needed, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-61582.desc: Chamilo LMS is an open-source learning management system. Prior to 1.11.40, main/inc/ajax/user_manager.ajax.php exposes the update_users action without an authorization check and stores attacker-controlled firstname, lastname, and email values without HTML sanitization. An unauthenticated attacker can modify another user's profile fields, and the stored content executes when user_portal.php, the administrative user listing, user information, social profile, course participant list, or message-composer recipient header renders the modified account. Targeting an administrator account can expose administrator-session data or permit actions in that session. This issue is fixed in version 1.11.40.
CVE-2026-61582.path: remote, no login, needs user action

CVE-2026-61583.title: Chamilo LMS: Authenticated RCE through .htaccess in dropbox
CVE-2026-61583.desc: Chamilo LMS is an open-source learning management system. Prior to 1.11.40, main/dropbox/dropbox_functions.inc.php accepts a literal .htaccess filename in the course dropbox and stores it in a directory served by Apache, where the file can alter handler behavior under the required AllowOverride All configuration. Any authenticated course participant can upload .htaccess and then upload a PHP payload disguised as a .gif, resulting in code execution as the web-server user when the dropbox tool is enabled. This can expose or modify the Chamilo installation, course content, and database credentials. This issue is fixed in version 1.11.40.
CVE-2026-61583.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-61584.desc: Chamilo LMS is an open-source learning management system. Prior to 1.11.40, main/inc/ajax/record_audio_rtc.ajax.php concatenates the user-controlled audio_dir parameter with the course document root and passes the result to recursive directory creation without path normalization. An authenticated course user can select directory paths outside the intended course storage tree wherever the web-server account has permission to create directories. The resulting filesystem changes can interfere with application layout or support a separate file-write or code-execution chain, although this endpoint alone is not shown to write attacker-selected file content outside the course tree. This issue is fixed in version 1.11.40.
CVE-2026-61584.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-71481.title: ALTCHA PHP: verifySolution bypasses HMAC signature check when challenge signature is absent
CVE-2026-71481.desc: ALTCHA PHP is a lightweight PHP library for creating and verifying ALTCHA challenges. From 2.0.0 until 2.0.3, the verifySolution method skips HMAC signature verification when a challenge payload omits the signature field, even when hmacSignatureSecret is configured. An attacker can remove the signature, supply attacker-selected low-difficulty challenge parameters, solve the resulting proof of work, and submit a payload that verifies successfully, bypassing the CAPTCHA control. This issue is fixed in version 2.0.3.
CVE-2026-71481.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-71499.title: cf-manager: SSRF via URL-based Worker deployment allows arbitrary code execution in victim Cloudflare accounts
CVE-2026-71499.desc: cf-manager is an all-in-one dashboard for managing multiple Cloudflare accounts and services. Prior to 1.1.2, worker/src/routes/workers.ts uses bare fetch(url) calls to retrieve user-supplied URLs and deploys the returned content as a Worker script using stored Cloudflare credentials. The multipart and JSON branches of POST /api/:accountId/workers and POST /api/batch-deploy accept URLs without protocol, destination, redirect, content-type, or response-size validation. An attacker with deployment API access, or unauthenticated access when API_SECRET is not configured, can make cf-manager access internal resources or fetch attacker-controlled JavaScript and execute it in the victim Cloudflare Workers account. This issue is fixed in version 1.1.2.
CVE-2026-71499.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-73864.title: install-artifact-from-github loads downloaded native artifacts without integrity verification
CVE-2026-73864.desc: install-artifact-from-github installs prebuilt native artifacts hosted by GitHub without compiling them locally. Prior to 1.7.0, bin/install-from-cache.js downloads a native .node artifact, allows RE2_DOWNLOAD_MIRROR to select a source, follows HTTP redirects including HTTPS-to-HTTP downgrades, and writes the decompressed response to the artifact path without cryptographic integrity verification before writing or loading it. An attacker who controls a configured mirror, replaces a release asset, or can modify plaintext transport can supply native code that executes when the consumer loads the artifact. Version 1.7.0 adds SHA-256 verification for default-GitHub-source downloads when the consuming package publishes an artifactHashes bag; configured mirrors and packages without a bag remain outside that verification.
CVE-2026-73864.path: remote, no login, needs user action

CVE-2026-75521.title: Miren Runtime: Authentication bypass in RPC layer: unverified TLS client certificates grant cluster superuser access
CVE-2026-75521.desc: Miren Runtime provides the runtime component for the Miren application platform. Prior to 0.11.1, the QUIC/HTTP3 RPC server on the default port 8443 uses tls.RequestClientCert and does not verify that presented certificates chain to the configured cluster certificate authority. The RPC authenticators derive a caller identity from PeerCertificates[0].Subject.CommonName without requiring a non-empty VerifiedChains value, and certificate identities bypass all RBAC checks. A network attacker who can reach the listener can present a self-signed certificate with an issuer distinguished name matching the public cluster CA subject and gain cluster superuser access, allowing disclosure, modification, or disruption of applications, sandboxes, disks, credentials, and other managed resources. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.1.
CVE-2026-75521.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-130001.title: Mustache for Ruby: RCE using built-in method access
CVE-2026-130001.desc:
> [!NOTE]
> The vulnerability was fully disclosed to the maintainer in private prior to security advisories were enabled for the project.
> This advisory presents a limited information for initial release to provide a time window for installing updates. Full information with PoCs would be added later.

## Summary
Mustache template engine for Ruby in versions 1.1.2 and earlier allows remote attackers to achieve arbitrary code execution through accessing specific built-in methods in an attacker-supplied template.

## Details
Mustache is often suggested as a safe simple template language to avoid SSTI vulnerabilities.[^1] [^2]

Mustache for Ruby up to version 1.1.2 did not properly restrict method access which allowed chaining multiple built-in methods to achieve arbitrary code execution.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Successful exploitation of this vulnerability does not depend on any configuration or objects passed to the template engine.
> An attacker controlling the template string can achieve arbitrary code execution without any additional requirements.

Additional methods provided by the application or installed gems can further expand the attack surface but exploitation was proven without them.

## PoC
All discovered payloads were tested using `ruby -e` shell commands with `mustache` as the only explicitly required gem:

```bash
ruby -e 'require "mustache"; puts Mustache.render("PAYLOAD GOES HERE", key: "value")'
```

CVE-2026-127095.desc: A flaw was found in ansible-builder. The regular expression used to strip comments from a collection's requirements.txt during introspection is susceptible to super-quadratic backtracking. A requirements file containing a line with a long run of internal whitespace and no comment character causes the comment-stripping routine to consume CPU time proportional to the square of the line length. An attacker who can get a victim to build an execution environment that includes an attacker-supplied collection can cause the ansible-builder build or introspect process to hang, resulting in a denial of service. This issue has no confidentiality or integrity impact.
CVE-2026-127095.path: local access needed, no login, needs user action

CVE-2026-127096.desc: A flaw was found in the Ansible language server shipped with the vscode-ansible extension. The regular expression used to extract documentation fragments from Ansible module files is susceptible to quadratic-time scanning. A module file containing a crafted documentation string causes the language server to consume excessive CPU while indexing it, freezing the language service in the developer's editor. An attacker who can get a developer to open or index a workspace containing an attacker-supplied collection can cause a denial of service of the editor language features. This issue has no confidentiality or integrity impact.
CVE-2026-127096.path: local access needed, no login, needs user action

CVE-2026-128667.desc: A Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in the admin panel of PHPGurukul News Portal Project V4.1 allows remote attackers to hijack the authentication of administrators and perform unauthorized state-changing actions, such as adding, editing, or deleting posts and sub-admins, or changing passwords, via crafted HTTP requests. This occurs because the application fails to implement anti-CSRF tokens for admin actions and permits destructive operations via HTTP GET requests.

CVE-2026-128668.desc: An Unrestricted File Upload vulnerability in the admin panel of PHPGurukul News Portal Project V4.1 allows authenticated attackers to upload files with arbitrary content by bypassing weak filename extension validation in add-post.php and change-image.php. Although files are renamed with an image extension upon storage, the lack of MIME type and content validation enables content spoofing, storage of malicious markup, and creates a vector for Remote Code Execution (RCE) with server misconfigurations or secondary Local File Inclusion.
CVE-2026-128668.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-128669.desc: A Session Fixation vulnerability exists in the admin login endpoint (/admin/index.php) of PHPGurukul News Portal Project V4.1. The application fails to regenerate the session identifier (PHPSESSID) upon successful authentication. A remote attacker can exploit this by setting a known session ID in the victim's browser prior to login. Once the victim authenticates, the attacker can reuse the fixed session ID to hijack the victim's authenticated session.
CVE-2026-128669.path: remote, no login, needs user action

CVE-2026-129829.desc: The rsyslog's`imuxsock` special parser can end up writing into the received message raw buffer when trying to replace the message timestamp with the system's timestamp. A local attacker with the ability to write to the `imuxsock` socket can leverage that by crafting a malformed PRI value with a short timestamp to lead the rsyslog to perform the out-of-bounds write.
CVE-2026-129829.path: local access needed, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-132136.desc: A weakness has been identified in Directus up to 12.6.1. Affected by this issue is the function getSecret of the file api/src/services/shares.ts of the component Share Login Service. This manipulation causes incorrect authorization. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.
CVE-2026-132136.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-62245.desc: X-Road is open-source data exchange layer software. Prior to 7.8.2, 7.7.3, and 7.6.4, HashChainVerifier in the common-message module resolves attacker-controlled batch-signature hash chains before verifying the message signature and signing certificate, without cycle detection, recursion-depth or total-step limits, or per-step memoization. A registered ecosystem member can send a small crafted hashchain MIME part with repeated or cyclic StepRef values so that verifyHashChain() performs exponential work or unbounded recursion before authentication. Repeated requests can exhaust Security Server proxy threads and deny data-exchange service, and a self-reference can raise an uncaught error. This issue is fixed in versions 7.8.2, 7.7.3, and 7.6.4.
CVE-2026-62245.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-62340.title: X-Road: Cross-instance global configuration poisoning via federated download
CVE-2026-62340.desc: X-Road is open-source data exchange layer software. Prior to .8.2, 7.7.3, and 7.6.5, the Security Server writes each downloaded federated global-configuration part under the X-Road instance identifier declared by the part itself without checking that the identifier matches the source ecosystem that signed and delivered it. A malicious or compromised federated ecosystem can provide a validly signed SHARED-PARAMETERS part naming a victim ecosystem, causing the part to be written as the victim's authoritative shared-params.xml. The poisoned configuration can persist across refreshes, add attacker-controlled trust material, and enable impersonation of victim members and Security Servers across every ecosystem federated with the malicious source. This issue is fixed in versions 7.8.2, 7.7.3, and 7.6.5.
CVE-2026-62340.path: remote, needs admin rights, no user action

CVE-2026-63129.title: mssql-mcp-core: SQL injection in mssql-mcp write tools via unparameterized table names and WHERE clauses
CVE-2026-63129.desc: mssql-mcp-core is the shared library that powers MSSQL MCP servers. Prior to core and server 0.6.0 and reader and writer 0.5.0, multiple database tools interpolate caller-controlled identifiers and predicates into T-SQL batches passed to Request.query() while parameterizing only data values. update_data, delete_data, insert_data, execute_transaction, create_table, create_index, and drop_table accept unsafe tableName, column, index, schema, or free-form whereClause input, while reader-tier list_databases interpolates stateFilter without runtime allowlist enforcement. Row-count and preview queries execute before confirmUpdate or confirmDelete, allowing malicious arguments to bypass confirmation and maxRows controls and execute stacked DDL or DML, read or destroy data, and potentially run operating-system commands when the SQL login is privileged and xp_cmdshell is enabled. This issue is fixed in core and server version 0.6.0 and reader and writer version 0.5.0.
CVE-2026-63129.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-63483.desc: X-Road is open-source data exchange layer software. Prior to 7.8.2 and 7.7.3, the Configuration Proxy uses attacker-controlled Content-location metadata from a validly signed federated global configuration part when constructing an output path without verifying that the resulting path remains inside the intended configuration output directory. A malicious or compromised federated ecosystem can provide an absolute path or directory traversal sequence during the normal refresh cycle, causing the Configuration Proxy to create a new file with attacker-controlled content under the permissions of the non-privileged xroad process. The vulnerability can poison downstream global configuration or create files in other writable locations, but it does not overwrite existing files. This issue is fixed in versions 7.8.2 and 7.7.3.
CVE-2026-63483.path: remote, needs admin rights, no user action

CVE-2026-68903.title: LLMKube: Arbitrary Host File Read via Model.spec.source hostPath Injection
CVE-2026-68903.desc: LLMKube is a Kubernetes operator for self-hosted large language model inference across heterogeneous hardware. Prior to 0.9.0, the ModelReconciler accepts arbitrary absolute paths and file:// URIs in Model.spec.source without restricting them to approved roots. A namespace user who can create or update Model and InferenceService resources can cause copyLocalModel to open an attacker-selected file in the controller pod or cause a HostPathVolumeSource to mount an attacker-selected node file when modelCache.enabled is enabled, which is the default. The selected file is copied into model storage and can expose controller service-account credentials or other node secrets outside the attacker's namespace. This issue is fixed in version 0.9.0.
CVE-2026-68903.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-71425.desc: Outstatic is a static site CMS for Markdown and MDX content stored in GitHub repositories. Prior to 2.2.1, the authenticated GitHub REST proxy accepts an unvalidated endpoint value, constructs an upstream URL by string concatenation, and attaches the current dashboard user's GitHub OAuth token without ensuring the destination remains the exact GitHub API origin. An authenticated dashboard user can cause the server to send that user's token to a non-GitHub host, potentially exposing private repositories and other resources allowed by the token's scopes. The issue does not let an unauthenticated attacker access private data and does not directly expose another user's token without an additional same-origin execution or request-forging primitive. This issue is fixed in version 2.2.1.
CVE-2026-71425.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-73504.desc: cassandra-jdbc-wrapper provides a JDBC-compliant API over the Java driver for Apache Cassandra. Prior to 4.16.4 and 5.0.2, DriverUtil.toStringWithoutSensitiveValues() and DriverUtil.redactSensitiveValuesInJdbcUrl() redact the password property but not the equally sensitive token property used for DataStax Astra and other token-based authentication. When DEBUG logging is enabled, SessionHolder passes connection properties and JDBC URLs containing token through these helpers, causing the live token to be written in plaintext when connections are acquired or released. An attacker who can read those logs can use the token to access Cassandra data and operations authorized to that credential. This issue is fixed in versions 4.16.4 and 5.0.2.
CVE-2026-73504.path: local access needed, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-76090.title: Tapir: Construction/decode RCE via property name -> raw case-class field (tapir-openapi-codegen)
CVE-2026-76090.desc: Tapir is a Scala library for describing HTTP APIs and exposing, consuming, and documenting them using open standards. Prior to 1.13.27, tapir-openapi-codegen-core generates Scala source from untrusted OpenAPI documents by interpolating object property names, query, header, and path parameter names, and operation tags without context-appropriate validation or escaping. Crafted names or values can break out of generated identifier or string-literal contexts and inject arbitrary Scala that executes when generated code is compiled or endpoints are assembled. This is a code-generation and build-time issue and does not make a running tapir server directly exploitable. This issue is fixed in version 1.13.27.
CVE-2026-76090.path: local access needed, no login, needs user action

CVE-2026-76807.title: Todoist MCP Server: Browser DNS rebinding lets websites write and delete Todoist data through local MCP server
CVE-2026-76807.desc: Todoist MCP Server provides tools that allow AI agents to access and modify a Todoist account. Prior to 10.3.3, the optional todoist-mcp-http server accepts browser-origin requests to POST /mcp without validating the Host and Origin headers or authenticating the browser caller. A malicious website can use DNS rebinding to reach the loopback listener and invoke MCP tools through StreamableHTTPServerTransport, which uses the server-held Todoist API key. This exposes Todoist account data and permits operations such as task creation, updates, completion, and deletion. The stdio transport is not browser-reachable and is not affected by this attack path. This issue is fixed in version 10.3.3.
CVE-2026-76807.path: remote, no login, needs user action

CVE-2026-130089.title: temporal-proxy request namespace can redirect a templated upstream and leak its API key
CVE-2026-130089.desc: A caller who can send requests to the temporal-proxy gRPC listener can obtain the static API key of an upstream whose address is templated from the request namespace, and then use that key directly against the upstream Temporal service. temporal-proxy does not validate the request namespace before rendering it into a templated upstream address, so when an upstream's hostPort is templated from the namespace, as in the published Temporal Cloud configuration example, a crafted namespace changes the host the proxy dials. If that upstream verifies TLS against the system trust store and sets no literal server name, a caller-controlled host with a publicly trusted certificate passes verification and receives the key. The built-in static-token and JWKS authenticators do not restrict namespaces, so any caller they admit can do this; an external authenticator that admits only listed namespaces prevents it. temporal-proxy versions 0.1.0 through 1.2.0 are affected. The issue is fixed in 1.0.2, 1.1.2, and 1.2.1, and releases before 1.0.0 receive no fix. Upgrade to the fixed release for the deployed minor release line, and rotate any upstream API key that untrusted callers could reach.
CVE-2026-130089.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130090.desc: When two templated upstreams in temporal-proxy render the same address, a request routed to one upstream can be sent under the other upstream's credential, namespace translation, and payload encryption keys. temporal-proxy pools connections for templated upstreams by rendered address and TLS server name only, although each upstream's outbound credential, namespace translation, and payload encryption keys, where configured, are attached to its connection. A request routed to one upstream can therefore be sent over the connection the other created, and the upstream Temporal service authorizes it as the other upstream's principal. Configuration validation rejects only identical hostPort values, so templates that differ in text but render the same address are accepted. This mixes the two upstreams' ordinary traffic, and a caller that an external authenticator restricts to one upstream's namespaces can use it to act under the other upstream's credential. Deployments with at most one templated upstream are not affected. temporal-proxy versions 0.1.0 through 1.1.1 are affected. The issue is fixed in 1.0.2, 1.1.2, and 1.2.0, and releases before 1.0.0 receive no fix. Upgrade to the fixed release for the deployed minor release line.
CVE-2026-130090.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130091.title: temporal-proxy can be terminated by memory exhaustion when decompressing stored payloads
CVE-2026-130091.desc: A caller with write permission in a namespace can terminate temporal-proxy through memory exhaustion by storing highly compressed payloads in Workflow history, and the stored history causes the same failure on every later read. temporal-proxy 1.2.0 decompresses every payload marked as compressed in the responses it forwards, whether or not compression is configured. Each payload is limited to 4 MiB after decompression, but the total for a response is not, and the decoded payloads are held in memory together. The caller can store many small, highly compressed payloads through the proxy or directly at the upstream Temporal service. When that history is read through the proxy, for example by a Worker processing a task, the proxy can run out of memory and be terminated. The codec server's /decode endpoint is affected in the same way when it is enabled. Only temporal-proxy 1.2.0 is affected; earlier versions do not decompress payloads. The issue is fixed in 1.2.1. Upgrade to 1.2.1 or later.
CVE-2026-130091.path: remote, needs a user login, no user action

CVE-2026-130092.title: Unauthenticated callers can exhaust temporal-proxy memory through unbounded request metrics
CVE-2026-130092.desc: A caller who can reach the temporal-proxy gRPC listener, with or without a valid credential, can grow the proxy's memory until the process is terminated by sending requests with many distinct gRPC method names. temporal-proxy labels its request metrics with the method name exactly as the caller sent it, and records every request, including those that authentication or routing reject. Each distinct method name adds metric series that are never removed. The series grow whether or not the metrics endpoint is scraped, and metric labels configured from request metadata multiply the growth. temporal-proxy versions 0.1.0-alpha.20260716 through 1.2.0 are affected. The issue is fixed in 1.0.2, 1.1.2, and 1.2.1, and releases before 1.0.0 receive no fix. Upgrade to the fixed release for the deployed minor release line.
CVE-2026-130092.path: remote, no login, no user action

CVE-2026-132137.desc: A vulnerability was identified in Relaticle up to 3.10.0. Such manipulation of the argument Target leads to authorization bypass. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. CVE-2026-132139.title: DrayTek Vigor2960 mainfunction.cgi setSWMProfile stack-based overflow

The vendor recommends: "1.5.1.6 isn't the latest version of 2960, the latest version fixes many security issues. And we have another one in our release plan which should solve the issues reported."

CVE-2026-132140.desc: A security vulnerability has been detected in DrayTek Vigor2960 up to 1.5.1.6. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file mainfunction.cgi of the component Apmcfg Upload. The manipulation leads to null pointer dereference.
